articles.title: Tyreek Hill's agent's warning came true, and his plans to return to the NFL are on hold for now
articles.standfirst: A possible reunion with the Kansas City Chiefs faces several obstacles
articles.summary: A possible reunion with the Kansas City Chiefs faces several obstacles
articles.body:
Tyreek Hill 's return to the NFL is taking longer than expected, and his agent's warning that there was no reason to rush the process has proved increasingly relevant.

The 32-year-old wide receiver remains a free agent after being released by the Miami Dolphins in February. Although the Kansas City Chiefs have been mentioned as a possible destination, no agreement has materialized, leaving Hill's immediate future uncertain.

Agent Drew Rosenhaus previously made clear that his client would not be pressured into returning before he was physically ready. Hill 's recovery from a serious knee injury has involved multiple surgeries, and reports indicated that he initially had no power in his left leg.

The injury occurred during Miami's September 2025 game against the New York Jets , when Hill dislocated his knee and suffered significant ligament damage, including a torn ACL.

The Dolphins subsequently moved on from the receiver, partly because of his scheduled $51 million salary-cap hit. Hill has since been working toward proving he can return to the field, but his rehabilitation has complicated attempts to find a new team.

The Chiefs are an obvious potential destination because Hill began his NFL career in Kansas City. Selected in the fifth round of the 2016 draft, he developed into one of the league's most explosive receivers before being traded to Miami in 2022.

Kansas City could use additional help at the position after injuries affected its receiving options, including Tyquan Thornton . However, a reunion would depend on Hill passing a physical and convincing the organization that he can contribute immediately.

Chiefs reporter Pete Sweeney discussed the possibility during an appearance with Trey Wingo: "I think the Chiefs will try to turn over every stone to try and get a quality receiver."

Sweeney also addressed the uncertainty surrounding Hill's fitness, explaining: "We had kind of heard locally that Tyreek Hill wouldn’t really be ready to pass a physical, take the field until early to mid November."

There are also questions about whether Kansas City would be comfortable bringing Hill back into its locker room.

"It's the type of player as well that it's ‘do we want to bring this player into the locker room?’ Just considering some of the off-the-field stuff, but at a certain point, the Chiefs showed us two weeks ago the off-the-field to them maybe doesn’t matter," Sweeney said.

The Chiefs have also been linked with Indianapolis Colts receiver Josh Downs . If Kansas City addresses its needs through a trade, Hill could become a less attractive option.

Injury and off-field issues add to the uncertainty

Hill 's recovery is not his only concern. In October 2026, a civil jury found him liable on two battery claims involving his estranged wife, adding another consideration for teams assessing whether to sign him.

His recent production also provides context. Hill hasn't recorded a 1,000-yard receiving season since 2023, while his 2025 campaign ended after just four games. He recorded 21 catches for 265 yards and one touchdown before suffering the knee injury.

Despite those setbacks, his speed and previous achievements could still make him an attractive addition if he demonstrates that he is healthy.

For now, however, there's no confirmed return date or contract agreement. Rosenhaus ' cautious approach reflects the reality that Hill needs to be physically prepared before another NFL opportunity becomes realistic.

A Chiefs reunion remains possible, but the receiver's health, Kansas City's other targets and the team's assessment of his circumstances will determine whether it happens.

articles.title: The $400,000 plot of land in Missouri that Patrick Mahomes turned into a luxurious, custom-built mansion
articles.standfirst: What began as an undeveloped property became an extraordinary private compound after nearly three years of construction and planning
articles.summary: What began as an undeveloped property became an extraordinary private compound after nearly three years of construction and planning
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes had already secured his financial future when he made a property investment in Missouri that would eventually become one of the most remarkable homes owned by an NFL superstar.

In September 2020, just months after agreeing to a historic contract extension with the Kansas City Chiefs , the quarterback purchased eight acres of undeveloped land in Belton for approximately $400,000.

The acquisition attracted relatively little attention at the time, particularly compared with the 10-year, $450 million deal Mahomes had signed that July. However, the purchase marked the beginning of an ambitious project that would take nearly three years to complete.

Rather than move into an existing mansion, Mahomes and his wife, Brittany , wanted a home designed specifically around their lifestyle, providing space for their growing family while incorporating the facilities needed for his football career.

By 2023, the empty plot had been transformed into an expansive private estate, with aerial photographs revealing a property containing amenities rarely found outside professional sporting facilities or luxury resorts.

The most distinctive feature of the estate is its private football field, which measures approximately 50 yards and includes the quarterback's personal logo at midfield.

His surname is painted across the end zone, while a soccer goal provides additional opportunities for family recreation on the grounds.

The property also features a par-three golf hole, swimming pool and landscaped pond with a fountain, creating an extensive outdoor entertainment space.

Inside the residence, reports describe contemporary interiors featuring bright walls, large sliding glass doors, glass partitions and spacious living areas overlooking the grounds.

A dedicated gym allows Mahomes to maintain his training routine at home, while additional storage accommodates his extensive collection of sneakers.

Brittany previously expressed her excitement about completing a property that reflected the couple's ambitions rather than simply purchasing an expensive existing residence.

"Finally we're gonna have a home that we built and has everything we could have ever dreamed of having," she said.

Although some estimates have placed the property's value at approximately $8 million, the final construction cost has not been publicly confirmed.

Why Patrick Mahomes invested in Missouri instead of Texas

Mahomes already had considerable experience in the property market before undertaking the Belton development, having purchased homes in both Missouri and Texas earlier in his career.

In March 2020, he and Brittany acquired a residence in Westlake, Texas, for approximately $3.37 million, providing another base during the NFL offseason.

However, building a custom property close to Kansas City offered practical advantages for a quarterback whose professional commitments kept him in Missouri throughout the football season.

The timing also reflected Mahomes ' long-term relationship with the Chiefs , with the land purchase following his agreement to remain with the franchise for another decade.

The estate's facilities provide opportunities for training and recreation without leaving home, while the surrounding acreage offers greater privacy than a conventional residential property.

Its development also coincided with major milestones in Mahomes ' career, including additional Super Bowl appearances and championships during the construction period.

What began as an undeveloped $400,000 plot ultimately became a personalized family retreat, illustrating how Mahomes used his success to establish roots in the community where he became an NFL superstar.

articles.title: Travis Kelce proves Brittany Mahomes and Andy Reid wrong following long-running controversy that hurt the Chiefs
articles.standfirst: Kansas City tight end has sided with NFL officials after reviewing the disputed play
articles.summary: Kansas City tight end has sided with NFL officials after reviewing the disputed play
articles.body:
Travis Kelce has challenged the reaction to one of the most controversial moments of the Kansas City Chiefs ' season, admitting that officials were justified in penalizing his teammate during the dramatic closing seconds against the Denver Broncos .

The Chiefs appeared to have snatched victory on November 1 when Patrick Mahomes connected with Rashee Rice in the end zone, completing what seemed to be a remarkable comeback at Empower Field at Mile High.

However, celebrations were cut short when right tackle Jaylon Moore was flagged for a false start, wiping out the touchdown and leaving Kansas City facing fourth-and-goal from the six-yard line.

Mahomes was sacked on the following play, confirming a 28-24 defeat that prompted immediate criticism of the officials from head coach Andy Reid and Mahomes ' wife, Brittany.

Reid insisted he had only seen Moore turn his head before the snap, while Brittany described the decision as the "weakest call I have ever seen" in an Instagram post.

But when the Kelce brothers examined the footage on their New Heights podcast, Travis reached a conclusion that contradicted both reactions.

Travis Kelce agrees with referees

Jason Kelce , who spent 13 seasons playing center for the Philadelphia Eagles , approached the incident by examining Kansas City's offensive line alignment and pre-snap communication.

The former All-Pro highlighted the difficulty of executing a silent cadence, particularly when right guard Trey Smith was looking toward Mahomes while center Creed Humphrey prepared to initiate the snap.

However, Jason argued that the surrounding confusion did not excuse Moore's movement.

"A lot of people are saying this isn't a penalty. I want to go on record. This is definitely a penalty," Jason said.

Travis immediately supported that interpretation, acknowledging the subtle movement that officials had identified.

"Yeah, he flinches," the Chiefs tight end responded.

Their assessment contrasted with Reid 's postgame explanation, when the veteran coach questioned whether Moore had committed an infraction.

"I saw him move his head, but I didn't see a false start," Reid said.

Replays showed Moore making a slight lower-body movement while turning toward Mahomes, providing the basis for the officials' decision.

Chiefs face costly discipline problem

Rather than continuing to debate the flag, Travis emphasized that Kansas City still had an opportunity to win after the five-yard penalty.

"At the end of the day, we still had another play," he said. "I'll take my guy Pat Mahomes on the six-yard line with the game on the line; I'll take that any day of the week."

Kelce also acknowledged his own mistakes, admitting that repeated procedural penalties had become a problem he needed to address.

"Penalties will kill you in this league, and right now we are killing ourselves in that regard. I'm at the forefront," he said.

Kansas City committed 11 penalties for 105 yards against Denver, compounding the frustration of surrendering an 11-point fourth-quarter advantage.

The defeat dropped the Chiefs to 5-2, while Denver improved to 6-2 and strengthened its position atop the AFC West.

Although Reid and Brittany questioned the decisive penalty, Kelce 's response shifted attention toward the mistakes Kansas City must eliminate to avoid another damaging defeat.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce's behavior toward Rashee Rice exposed: “It's what a friend would do”
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City receiver's financial problems have prompted Craig Carton to challenge the meaning of friendship
articles.summary: The Kansas City receiver's financial problems have prompted Craig Carton to challenge the meaning of friendship
articles.body:
R ashee Rice 's financial troubles have become an unexpected source of controversy for the Kansas City Chiefs , with Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce facing questions about whether their public support for the receiver has translated into help behind the scenes.

Rice filed for Chapter 7 bankruptcy protection in Texas on Wednesday, disclosing more than $3.45 million in liabilities against approximately $677,000 in assets.

The filing revealed the extent of the financial pressures facing the 26-year-old, whose legal difficulties following a serious 2024 traffic collision have resulted in substantial outstanding obligations.

However, broadcaster Craig Carton believes the situation raises another question, particularly for a Chiefs organization whose biggest stars frequently describe their teammates as family.

Speaking on Friday's edition of The Craig Carton Show, Carton questioned why wealthy players such as Mahomes and Kelce hadn't apparently prevented Rice from reaching such a difficult financial position.

His comments have generated debate, although there's no publicly established evidence that either player refused to help Rice or that they were asked to provide financial assistance.

Carton expressed sympathy for Rice before turning his attention toward the relationships within Kansas City's locker room.

"I feel bad for Rashee Rice. I'm not one of these guys who gloats and likes watching the financial downfall of athletes," Carton said.

"But it pisses me off because he is surrounded by multimillionaires, guys we're constantly told are like family to him, that are brothers to him."

The broadcaster recalled September 2025, when Kelce and other Chiefs players wore shirts displaying Rice 's image while the receiver served a six-game NFL suspension.

Mahomes also publicly showed support during that period, reinforcing the impression of a close relationship between the quarterback and his young receiver.

Carton acknowledged that professional athletes cannot reasonably be expected to assume responsibility for their teammates' personal finances.

"It's not their responsibility to bail him out financially. I'm not saying it is. But it's what a friend would do," he argued.

He also questioned why such visible public solidarity hadn't been accompanied by financial support, although any private assistance remains unknown.

Financial troubles reveal serious consequences of Dallas crash

Rice 's bankruptcy documents identify substantial debts connected to the March 2024 highway collision in Dallas that injured several people.

The receiver pleaded guilty to two third-degree felony offenses in July 2025 and received five years of probation alongside a 30-day jail sentence.

His largest listed creditor is owed approximately $979,837 following a civil settlement related to the incident.

The filing also identifies Rice 's Super Bowl LVIII championship ring, valued at $160,000, as collateral securing outstanding legal fees.

"Think about how humbling it is to have to put your Super Bowl ring up," Carton said while criticizing what he perceived as insufficient support from the Chiefs.

Rice is currently in the final season of his four-year rookie contract, originally worth approximately $6.5 million.

Neither Mahomes nor Kelce has publicly responded to Carton's accusations, leaving their private involvement in Rice's financial situation unclear.

While the broadcaster has challenged the strength of Kansas City's locker room relationships, the bankruptcy filing establishes Rice 's financial difficulties rather than the actions or intentions of his teammates.

articles.title: Benched because of TikTok? Andy Reid's rumored social media ban claims another victim from the Chiefs
articles.summary: Kingsley Suamataia's unexplained absence from the Kansas City Chiefs' starting offensive line has become one of the team's more unusual controversies, with a former player suggesting that his TikTok videos could be behind the decision.
articles.body:
Kingsley Suamataia 's unexplained absence from the Kansas City Chiefs ' starting offensive line has become one of the team's more unusual controversies, with a former player suggesting that his TikTok videos could be behind the decision.

The 23-year-old guard was left out of the offensive rotation during Kansas City's 28-24 defeat to the Denver Broncos , despite being available throughout the week and previously showing encouraging signs of development.

It marked the second time this season that Suamataia had been replaced by veteran Mike Caliendo, with head coach Andy Reid offering little explanation for the unexpected change.

However, former Chiefs wide receiver Gehrig Dieter believes the situation could involve something beyond Suamataia 's performances, pointing toward Reid's longstanding preference for limiting outside distractions.

Dieter 's theory centers on the lineman's social media presence, particularly videos showing him dancing on TikTok.

Although there is no confirmed connection between those posts and the lineup decision, Dieter believes his own experience in Kansas City provides insight into how Reid approaches such activities.

Speaking on Sports Radio 810 WHB, Dieter suggested that Suamataia's online activity might have attracted unwanted attention from the coaching staff.

"It's got to be these TikToks," Dieter said. "I'm serious. I'm telling you, it's these TikTok dances he's doing."

The former receiver recalled launching a YouTube channel during his time with Kansas City, only to receive a message indicating that Reid was uncomfortable with the project.

"My second or third year, I did a YouTube channel for like four episodes, three episodes," Dieter explained.

"And [Ted Crews] came down, and he was like, 'Coach Reid doesn't really like that type of thing.' So then I stopped."

Dieter went further, arguing that he would share similar concerns about offensive linemen attracting attention through elaborate social media performances.

"As a coach, I don't want to see my guys out there just dancing like that," he said, acknowledging that his position might sound unusual," Dieter added.

However, Reid has offered a different explanation for Suamataia 's absence, explicitly denying that the decision was disciplinary.

"I didn't say it was punishment ever," Reid told reporters. "So, this was just between Kingsley and I, working some things out here."

Kelce supports Suamataia amid uncertain Chiefs future

Suamataia's situation has attracted attention because his removal came despite a promising performance against the Seattle Seahawks the previous week.

The young offensive lineman received an 84.8 pass-blocking grade from Pro Football Focus in that game, making his subsequent absence difficult to explain through recent performance alone.

Travis Kelce has also expressed support for his teammate, emphasizing that Suamataia remains an important member of Kansas City's locker room.

"He's family. Everybody has their own road. We love Kingsley, and we think he's a hell of a player," Kelce said.

The tight end acknowledged that he did not know the full circumstances behind the coaching decision but expected Suamataia to remain determined to regain his place.

Meanwhile, Suamataia has continued posting on social media, sharing messages about perseverance and his determination to overcome setbacks.

Reid has indicated that the guard could return against the New York Jets, potentially providing an opportunity to move beyond the controversy.

Until the Chiefs explain the decision more fully, Dieter 's suggestion remains speculation rather than proof of an unofficial TikTok ban.

articles.title: The $1 Million Scam? An inside look at bizarre ring-smuggling scheme involving Super Bowl-winning Chiefs
articles.standfirst: A shipment disguised as metal hairpins contained 75 counterfeit Kansas City championship rings
articles.summary: A shipment disguised as metal hairpins contained 75 counterfeit Kansas City championship rings
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs ' championship success has made their Super Bowl memorabilia highly desirable among collectors, but that popularity has also attracted counterfeiters attempting to profit from the franchise's reputation.

Federal authorities in Houston have uncovered another example after intercepting a suspicious package containing 75 counterfeit championship rings, despite shipping documents identifying its contents as inexpensive metal hairpins.

The shipment arrived at George Bush Intercontinental Airport from Guangzhou, China, on October 30, before customs officers noticed irregularities that prompted a closer inspection.

What initially appeared to be a routine commercial delivery quickly became an intellectual property investigation involving US Customs and Border Protection and the NFL .

Officers discovered rings resembling those awarded to members of Kansas City's championship teams, but their poor workmanship raised immediate doubts about their authenticity.

The NFL subsequently confirmed that the merchandise was counterfeit, leading authorities to seize the entire shipment and alert Homeland Security Investigations.

According to federal officials, genuine versions of the rings would have carried a combined retail value of at least $750,000, although that does not represent actual criminal proceeds.

How customs officers uncovered fake Chiefs Super Bowl rings

The investigation began when officers examined an express consignment parcel that had entered the United States under the description "Hair Pins Metal."

Instead, the package contained championship-style jewelry featuring branding associated with one of the NFL's most successful franchises of recent years.

Customs officials identified what they described as "poor craftsmanship" and contacted the league, which holds the relevant trademark rights, for authentication.

After receiving confirmation that the rings were unauthorized reproductions, CBP's Trade Enforcement Team determined that the shipment violated intellectual property protections.

The agency subsequently provided investigators with information about the importer, although no arrests or criminal charges have been publicly announced.

"Legitimate American businesses are often harmed by these global criminal organizations," CBP Acting Director of Field Operations Leslie Fleming-Luczkowski said in a statement.

"The sale of fake goods often funds money laundering, drug trafficking, and other illegal activities," she added, emphasizing the broader concerns surrounding counterfeit merchandise.

Why counterfeiters keep targeting Kansas City Chiefs

The latest interception isn't an isolated incident, with authorities having previously discovered substantial shipments of fake championship rings linked to Kansas City.

In 2022, customs officers seized 80 counterfeit Chiefs Super Bowl LIV rings alongside unauthorized jewelry representing several other major American sports franchises.

Another interception in March 2024 uncovered 60 counterfeit Chiefs rings , including reproductions commemorating the franchise's 1969 and 2019 championship seasons.

That shipment also contained fake Kansas City Royals and Kansas Jayhawks rings, with the combined merchandise valued at approximately $2.71 million had it been authentic.

Across the three documented cases, federal authorities have now intercepted 215 counterfeit Chiefs championship rings, although there is no established connection between those shipments.

The cases illustrate the appeal of championship memorabilia to collectors and the opportunities it creates for sellers attempting to pass unauthorized products off as genuine.

While the Houston seizure represents another successful interception, investigators have not publicly identified who ordered the latest shipment or where the rings were ultimately intended to be sold.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes celebrates a crucial Kansas City Current win without Patrick Mahomes
articles.standfirst: The businesswoman enjoyed her team's playoff run alongside her three children and her mother.
articles.summary: The businesswoman enjoyed her team's playoff run alongside her three children and her mother.
articles.body:
Some family outings turn into especially memorable occasions, and Brittany Mahomes had one of those on Saturday, November 7. The businesswoman arrived at CPKC Stadium with her three children to watch the Kansas City Current take on Angel City FC in the 2026 NWSL playoffs .

Patrick Mahomes was unable to join them, as the Kansas City Chiefs have a regular-season NFL game scheduled for Sunday . Still, Brittany enjoyed the afternoon with Sterling, Patrick, and Golden, who arrived ready to cheer on the team in their jerseys and playful face paint designs.

The oldest chose a unicorn, Patrick transformed into Spider-Man, and Golden, the youngest, sported a soccer ball painted on her cheek . Among the photos Brittany shared on her Instagram Stories was also a sweet picture of Sterling alongside her grandmother, Diana Lindenberg, who joined the family for the outing.

Brittany's presence also carried special significance: she is a co-owner of the Kansas City Current, making the result particularly meaningful to her beyond the family outing . And the team gave her another reason to celebrate.

Michelle Cooper scores in the 96th minute to send the Current to the semifinals

The matchup against Angel City FC remained scoreless throughout regulation. The breakthrough came in stoppage time after a foul on Haley Hopkins inside the penalty area gave the home side a chance from the spot .

Michelle Cooper stepped up and converted the penalty in the 96th minute. Her goal sealed the 1-0 victory and secured the Kansas City Current's place in the semifinals.

The home team had created more scoring opportunities throughout the match, finishing with 16 shots compared to Angel City FC's seven. However, it took that late chance to finally break the deadlock. The loss also brought an end to Angel City FC's 10-game unbeaten streak.

With their semifinal spot secured, the Current will now face the winner of the matchup between NJ/NY Gotham FC and Seattle Reign FC, who will determine their next opponent for next weekend's semifinal round.

articles.title: Chiefs owner's eldest daughter Gracie Hunt celebrates her bachelorette party with a western twist
articles.standfirst: The businesswoman shared photos from her celebration.
articles.summary: The businesswoman shared photos from her celebration.
articles.body:
G racie Hunt, the eldest daughter of Kansas City Chiefs owner Clark Hunt , shared photos from her bachelorette party, where western-inspired style set the tone and her outfit changes caught everyone's attention.

“The last splash.” With those words, Gracie captioned a series of photos in which she posed in a white two-piece bikini . The playful phrase alluded to her final days as a single woman and set the tone for the celebrations ahead.

The western theme also carried over into another post, titled “Wild Wild Wifey Recap,” where she shared different moments from the gathering. This time, the outfits and details inspired by the Old West took center stage.

The boho-chic dress and bridal detail that caught everyone's attention

For one of the celebration's looks, Gracie opted for a champagne-colored mini dress featuring a woven texture, square neckline, and geometric details. The design included side cutouts that revealed part of her midriff, while a skirt with delicate ruffles added a romantic touch .

Camel suede boots completed the outfit, while ivory and gold accessories, delicate jewelry, and her blonde hair styled in voluminous waves maintained the ensemble's boho-chic aesthetic.

One accessory, however, stood out among the photos: a hat paired with a small veil. The bridal detail added a wedding-inspired touch to her look, bringing together the cowboy theme and the occasion's main purpose .

Who is Derek Green, Gracie Hunt's future husband?

Her fiancé also has ties to the NFL. Derek Green is the son of Trent Green, a former quarterback who played for the Kansas City Chiefs and finished his professional career with 28,475 passing yards and 162 touchdowns .

Gracie and Derek met in 2017 through their connection to the Kansas City team. Their friendship eventually turned into a romantic relationship in May 2025, and less than a year later, he proposed.

For now, the couple has not publicly announced their wedding date. In the meantime, Gracie is enjoying some of the traditions that come with this special chapter and the excitement of preparing to become a wife.

articles.title: Chiefs close in on Broncos with plenty at stake in their next NFL game
articles.standfirst: Kansas City hosts the New York Jets at a crucial point in its season, with a chance to make up ground and stay within reach of the top spot in its division.
articles.summary: Kansas City hosts the New York Jets at a crucial point in its season, with a chance to make up ground and stay within reach of the top spot in its division.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs opened the 2026 season as one of the teams to watch. They won their first five games, took control of the AFC West and gave their fans plenty of reasons to believe . It looked as though they had found their way back to the top early in the season, but the past few weeks have changed the picture. A string of losses brought their momentum to a halt and dropped them from first to second place in the division, while the Denver Broncos took advantage and moved into the lead.

Still, the Chiefs have plenty to play for, and they cannot afford to dwell on what they have let slip away.

Their first chance to turn things around comes this Sunday, November 8, when they host the New York Jets at Arrowhead Stadium . Playing in front of their home crowd gives Kansas City a favorable setting to get back in the win column and start making up ground, but they will have to deliver on the field.

articles.standfirst: Chiefs and Jets clash at Arrowhead: Mahomes' machine hosts a Jets team desperate for breathing room
articles.summary: Chiefs and Jets clash at Arrowhead: Mahomes' machine hosts a Jets team desperate for breathing room
articles.body:
The NFL Week 9 schedule features a matchup with a clear favorite but plenty of reasons to watch. T he Kansas City Chiefs host the New York Jets at Arrowhead Stadium, a venue that almost always ends up being one-sided.

The home team comes into this matchup firmly in the hunt near the top of the AFC; the visitors, meanwhile, are looking to halt a season that has gone downhill. Here’s everything you need: when it is, what time it starts, where to watch it, and what’s at stake.

New York Jets vs Kansas City Chiefs: When and where to watch live

The game will be played this Sunday, November 8, 2026, at Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City, a colossus with a capacity for 76,416 fans. The game’s start time will be:

In the United States, the national television broadcast is handled by CBS; while streaming, you can watch it on: Paramount+, NFL+, Fubo, Hulu + Live TV, YouTube TV, and DIRECTV.

Overview of Jets vs Chiefs: two opposite trajectories

The standings photo says almost everything. Kansas City is 5-2, a record that places them second in the AFC West, behind the Denver Broncos, who lead the division at 6-2.

In the overall AFC standings, the Chiefs appear in fifth place in the conference group, tied in winning percentage with Jacksonville and Cincinnati. Their point differential is solid: 167 scored and only 131 allowed, the best defensive balance among the teams battling near the top in that area.

The Jets, meanwhile, are at the opposite end of the map. With 2 wins and 6 losses, they sit in third place in the AFC East, far behind the Buffalo Bills, who are dominating with a 6-1 record, and below the New England Patriots.

They have scored 170 points and conceded 188, a negative differential that reflects how inconsistent their season has been. In the conference standings they are in twelfth place, practically out of reach of the postseason spots at this stage.

The key matchup: elite offense against a tightening defense

The main attraction of this game is under center. Patrick Mahomes, the Chiefs' quarterback, once again serves as the focal point of an offense that combines verticality and control. At 31, Mahomes has an arsenal of young, explosive receivers as well as veteran tight end Travis Kelce, 37, who remains a reliable safety valve on short chains.

In the running game, Kenneth Walker III brings a power dimension that Kansas City has not always had in recent years. Kansas City also has Justin Fields as the backup quarterback, a luxury insurance policy on the depth chart.

On the other side, the Jets are entrusting their offense to 36-year-old Geno Smith, with the mission of supporting a group that needs points. Their best weapon remains receiver Garrett Wilson, one of the few names capable of winning individual matchups on his own, accompanied by running back Breece Hall, who, when he gets going, brings balance to the attack.

The challenge is enormous: Kansas City's defense is, by the numbers, among the stingiest of the AFC contenders, and Arrowhead is one of the most hostile environments in the league for a visiting offense.

What's at stake in the NFL standings

For the Chiefs, every victory is oxygen in an AFC West that Denver controls with a firm hand. Kansas City is one win away in percentage terms from the Broncos, so it cannot afford slip-ups against theoretically inferior rivals if it wants to challenge for the top of the division and, at the same time, fight for a better seed heading into the playoffs.

A result like this, at home and as the favorite, falls squarely into the category of "must-win games."

The margin for error is slim because the conference is tightly packed: six teams in the American Conference have five or more wins, and tiebreakers come down to the smallest details. Winning and keeping the defense’s goal line as clean as possible helps both in the standings and in the point differential.

On the other side, the Jets are settled in the group of those looking down. Their 2-6 record is only better, in the AFC East, than that of a struggling Miami Dolphins team (1-6). In the conference as a whole , New York shares the burden with Indianapolis (2-6) and stands ahead only of Miami, Tennessee, and a Los Angeles Chargers team that has yet to win a game (0-7).

For New York, the goal is no longer so much qualification as rebuilding the season, gaining confidence, and showing that the project still has life. A statement win at Arrowhead would be the surprise of the day and would change the mood of a locker room that needs good news.

What is the prediction for the Kansas City Chiefs vs New York Jets?

Everything points to Kansas City. At home, with a defense that gives up little, with Mahomes leading, and with an opponent arriving banged up and holding a 2-6 record, the scenario is favorable for the Chiefs.

The Jets have the specific talent—Wilson and Hall—to do damage if they find an early rhythm, but sustaining that level for sixty minutes at Arrowhead is another story. The logical bet is a Chiefs victory, with enough room to control the scoreboard in the second half.

Prediction: The Kansas City Chiefs win comfortably against a New York Jets team that will make them work for the victory in the first quarter.

articles.title: Will Taylor Swift be supporting Travis Kelce at the Chiefs vs Jets game?
articles.standfirst: The singer is expected to return to Arrowhead Stadium on Sunday after missing Kansas City's recent road defeat against the Denver Broncos
articles.summary: The singer is expected to return to Arrowhead Stadium on Sunday after missing Kansas City's recent road defeat against the Denver Broncos
articles.body:
Taylor Swift could be back in the stands to cheer on Travis Kelce when the Kansas City Chiefs welcome the New York Jets to Arrowhead Stadium on Sunday, November 8.

The pop superstar has made a habit of attending her husband's home games this season, making this weekend's matchup one of the more likely occasions for another high-profile appearance.

There is, however, no official confirmation that Swift will be inside the stadium. Her previous appearances provide a strong indication, but the singer has maintained control over when she is seen in public and does not attend every game on the road.

The Chiefs-Jets contest is scheduled to begin at noon Central Time, with CBS broadcasting the Week 9 matchup. Kansas City will be looking to respond after suffering consecutive defeats against the Seattle Seahawks and Denver Broncos .

Swift was not spotted at the team's latest outing, a 28-24 loss to Denver on November 1. According to reports, she was in New York City that day for a screening and question-and-answer event connected to Toy Story 5.

She wrote the film's song, "I Knew It, I Knew You," and her appearance at the event offered an explanation for why she was elsewhere while Kelce and his teammates were playing.

Her absence also continued a pattern that has become increasingly noticeable: Swift has attended Kansas City's home games but has not been seen at its away fixtures this season. Security considerations have reportedly played a part in that decision.

Why Arrowhead Stadium could bring Taylor Swift back

The Chiefs ' home venue has become the most reliable setting for fans hoping to catch a glimpse of Swift during the NFL season. She attended Kansas City's September 14 season opener against the Denver Broncos, sitting alongside actor Tom Cruise.

She also returned for the October 18 home matchup against the Los Angeles Chargers , where she was seen with Indiana Fever star Caitlin Clark and singer Este Haim.

Her appearances have attracted considerable attention, but Swift has previously explained that her priority is supporting Kelce rather than becoming part of the television coverage.

In a 2023 interview with Time, she said: "I’m just there to support Travis. I have no awareness of if I’m being shown too much and pissing off a few dads, Brads, and Chads."

She also discussed how difficult it can be to know when cameras are showing her during a game, adding: "I don’t know how they know what suite I’m in," before explaining that she cannot tell how often the broadcast features her.

Sports Illustrated's August preview of the 2026 season identified the Jets matchup as one of the home games Swift was likely to attend.

The publication highlighted her established preference for Arrowhead and the lack of a scheduled performance that would conflict with the November 8 fixture.

Swift and Kelce , who married in July 2026, have continued to support each other's careers. Kelce has attended major events involving the singer, while she has regularly made time for his football commitments.

The Chiefs will hope the home crowd can help them rediscover their winning form against the Jets. For Swift's fans, meanwhile, Sunday's game offers another opportunity to see whether she returns to her familiar spot in the stands.

For now, the expectation is that she could be there, but until she is spotted at Arrowhead, her attendance remains unconfirmed.

articles.title: Patriots legend changes Travis Kelce's position to separate him from Rob Gronkowski: “He’s a receiver”
articles.standfirst: Rob Ninkovich has reignited the greatest tight end debate
articles.summary: Rob Ninkovich has reignited the greatest tight end debate
articles.body:
Rob Gronkowski 's induction into the New England Patriots Hall of Fame brought together some of the franchise's most recognizable figures, but an unexpected comparison with Travis Kelce ensured the celebration extended beyond the retired star's achievements.

Former Patriots linebacker Rob Ninkovich used Saturday's ceremony in Foxborough to question whether Kansas City's three-time Super Bowl champion should even be judged alongside Gronkowski when discussing the greatest tight ends in NFL history.

The two players have dominated the position across different eras, combining exceptional receiving production with their roles in two of football's most successful dynasties.

However, Ninkovich believes the distinction between their playing styles is significant enough to separate them, particularly when considering the traditional responsibilities of a tight end.

"Kelce and this guy don't even come close," Ninkovich said during Gronkowski's induction ceremony. "He's a receiver, and this guy is a tight end."

The assessment reflects Ninkovich 's longstanding belief that Gronkowski 's willingness to block defensive linemen made him more valuable than his receiving statistics alone might suggest.

Gronkowski spent nine seasons alongside Tom Brady in New England, becoming a crucial component of an offense that could dominate opponents through both passing and rushing plays.

His physicality allowed the Patriots to use him as an additional blocker without sacrificing the threat of an explosive reception, creating difficult matchups for opposing defenses.

Across his New England career, Gronkowski recorded 521 catches for 7,861 yards and 79 receiving touchdowns while helping the franchise capture three Super Bowl championships.

Ninkovich has criticized Kelce 's blocking before, arguing during a 2018 podcast appearance that the Chiefs star didn't embrace that responsibility in the same way.

"I mean, I've played against Kelce, and I've thrown him around like he's a little doll," he said. "The guy doesn't want to block, so when you're a tight end, and you don't want to block, you're not really a tight end."

However, Kelce 's achievements present a different measure of excellence. His receiving production has surpassed Gronkowski's career totals, while his partnership with Patrick Mahomes has transformed Kansas City's passing attack.

Kelce and Gronkowski show mutual respect

The debate has continued throughout Kelce 's career, although Gronkowski himself has resisted framing their contrasting styles as evidence that one player is inherently superior.

"We're both also different style players," Gronkowski previously explained, acknowledging that Kansas City's offense demands different responsibilities from its tight ends.

Kelce has similarly expressed admiration for the former Patriots star, despite repeatedly being compared with him throughout his professional career.

"I might be one of the biggest Gronk fans out there, let it be told," Kelce said during a 2021 interview with Fanatics View.

The Kansas City veteran has also acknowledged the inevitability of comparisons between elite players, although he previously admitted disliking the nickname "Baby Gronk."

Both men have won multiple championships and redefined expectations for their position, even if their approaches have differed considerably.

Ninkovich 's comments underline why the argument remains unresolved, with Gronkowski 's physical dominance and Kelce 's receiving longevity offering competing definitions of what makes an exceptional tight end.

articles.title: Linda Cohn upset with Brittany Mahomes over her latest comments: “You may need to expand your group chat”
articles.standfirst: The former ESPN anchor has challenged Patrick Mahomes' wife over her accusations of unfair officiating
articles.summary: The former ESPN anchor has challenged Patrick Mahomes' wife over her accusations of unfair officiating
articles.body:
Linda Cohn has questioned Brittany Mahomes ' perspective on NFL officiating after the wife of Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes suggested her husband's team had been unfairly targeted during a controversial defeat to the Denver Broncos .

The former ESPN SportsCenter anchor addressed Brittany 's complaints on her self-titled podcast, arguing that her frustration overlooked a longstanding debate among NFL supporters about whether Kansas City receives favorable decisions from officials.

Brittany 's comments followed the Chiefs' 28-24 defeat in Denver on November 1, when a late penalty erased what appeared to be the winning touchdown and left Kansas City facing a second consecutive loss.

Patrick Mahomes had connected with Rashee Rice in the end zone during the closing seconds, but right tackle Jaylon Moore was penalized for a false start before the snap.

The Chiefs were moved back five yards, and Denver defensive lineman Malcolm Roach subsequently sacked Mahomes on the final play to secure the victory.

"You can't tell me you call that on a game-winning TD, oh wait yeah I can cause it's us," Brittany wrote on Instagram, describing the decision as the weakest she had witnessed.

Cohn took particular issue with Brittany 's suggestion that the Chiefs were being singled out, pointing toward years of complaints from opposing fans who believe Kansas City has benefited from controversial calls.

"Are you kidding me, Brittany? Brittany, have you heard the conversations happening constantly outside Kansas City for the last few years? You may need to expand your group chat," Cohn said.

The veteran broadcaster argued that Brittany 's comments would inevitably attract criticism because of the Chiefs ' recent history of success and the public scrutiny surrounding officiating in their games.

"So you can understand why people hear 'because it's us' and think, 'Are we remembering the same football games, Brittany?' You saw those," she added.

Kansas City coach Andy Reid also questioned the penalty, explaining that he noticed Moore turn his head but didn't believe the movement constituted a false start.

However, Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce subsequently acknowledged on the New Heights podcast that Moore had moved before the snap, offering a different interpretation of the decision.

Cohn also questions Kelly Stafford complaints

Cohn extended her criticism to Kelly Stafford , whose husband Matthew quarterbacks the Los Angeles Rams , after she questioned the team's unusually short bye-week period.

Kelly complained that Los Angeles would have only 10 days between its November 15 meeting with Arizona and its November 25 game against Green Bay.

Cohn acknowledged that concerns about player recovery were legitimate but questioned whether complaints about personal exhaustion would generate sympathy from ordinary supporters.

"Kelly makes the case for player recovery that's a conversation worth having. Just understand why your own game day exhaustion might not generate the sympathy you expect," she said.

The broadcaster emphasized that neither woman should be discouraged from expressing opinions simply because of her husband's career.

"Marriage to a quarterback doesn't disqualify you from commentary, from having an opinion. It also doesn't exempt your commentary from criticism," Cohn explained.

Her final message encouraged both women to consider how their public statements might sound beyond their immediate circles, concluding with three words: "Know the room."

articles.title: A sarcastic comment about Taylor Swift causes backlash against Bill Maher
articles.standfirst: The comedian reignited criticism over his repeated jokes about the pop superstar
articles.summary: The comedian reignited criticism over his repeated jokes about the pop superstar
articles.body:
Bill Maher 's habit of making Taylor Swift the punchline of his jokes has once again generated controversy, with the comedian drawing audible groans from his television audience after taking another swipe at the singer's personal life.

The latest incident occurred during Friday's episode of HBO's Real Time, when Maher was discussing the results of the 2026 US midterm elections and the changing political preferences of American voters.

While examining the Republican Party's losses, the 70-year-old comedian highlighted a reported decline in President Donald Trump 's support among younger white men before unexpectedly introducing Swift into the discussion.

"[Trump] lost the bros. The Bros, dude," Maher said. "Young white men. Huge swing, like 28 points. Taylor Swift hasn't lost this many white guys."

The remark prompted a mixture of laughter, applause and audible groans from the studio audience, suggesting that not everyone appreciated the reference to Swift's previous relationships.

Although Maher regularly uses celebrities in his political comedy, the latest joke attracted additional attention because it followed another controversial comparison involving the singer just days earlier.

During his October 30 broadcast, Maher had discussed his increasingly strained relationship with Trump after the president criticized him in a lengthy social media post.

The comedian compared the fallout from their dinner together to dating Swift, referencing the singer's reputation for drawing inspiration from past relationships.

"Eating with Trump is like dating Taylor Swift," Maher said. "It's a lot of laughs at the time, but later on, they're tearing you a new asshole."

The joke was another example of Maher 's longstanding willingness to comment publicly on Swift 's relationships, which have frequently attracted considerable media attention.

articles.title: Taylor Swift’s former best friend Karlie Kloss returns to her side at Chiefs game
articles.standfirst: The relationship between the singer and the supermodel had been the subject of speculation for years
articles.summary: The relationship between the singer and the supermodel had been the subject of speculation for years
articles.body:
T aylor Swift and Karlie Kloss have given fans another reason to believe their once-famous friendship is back on track. The former best friends were spotted together Sunday at Arrowhead Stadium, watching the Kansas City Chiefs take on the New York Jets in a reunion that comes months after Kloss received a surprise invitation to Swift and Travis Kelce’s wedding.

Swift, 36, and Kloss, 33, were seen chatting and smiling inside a VIP suite during the first half of the game. Swift wore a red top as she watched her husband and the Chiefs, while Kloss appeared nearby in good spirits . Swift’s parents, Andrea and Scott Swift, were also in attendance.

The appearance was particularly notable because the relationship between the singer and the supermodel had been the subject of speculation for years. Once inseparable, the pair had seemingly drifted apart, fueling reports of a falling-out and questions about whether their friendship could ever be repaired.

The wedding invitation that changed it all

Those questions gained new attention in July, when Kloss and her husband, Joshua Kushner , attended Swift and Kelce’s lavish wedding at Madison Square Garden in New York City.

Their presence surprised some observers. Before the ceremony, reports had suggested Kloss might not make the guest list because of the rumored tension between the two women. Instead, she was among the guests at the July 3 celebration, which brought together an enormous group of celebrities, athletes and friends.

The wedding invitation appeared to signal that the former friends had put their differences aside. An insider reportedly told TMZ that Swift and Kloss had reconciled, clearing the way for the model to attend the celebration.

Sunday’s appearance at Arrowhead offered another public indication that the relationship may be on better terms. While neither woman has publicly addressed the reunion in detail, their relaxed interaction in the suite suggested there was no obvious awkwardness between them.

Another high-profile moment

The Chiefs game was another opportunity to support Kelce during the NFL season. Swift's relationship with the Kansas City tight end has made her a familiar presence at Arrowhead, where her appearances regularly attract attention beyond the football field.

The outing for Kloss marked another high-profile moment alongside someone who was once among her closest friends. The two were frequently photographed together during the height of their friendship, becoming one of pop culture’s most recognizable celebrity pairings.

Their apparent reconciliation has also drawn attention because of the years of speculation surrounding their relationship. Neither has offered a detailed explanation of what may have caused the distance, leaving fans to interpret the wedding invitation and their latest public appearance as signs of a renewed friendship.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes' arm injury alarms the Chiefs and sends shockwaves through Arrowhead
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City quarterback set off alarm bells after briefly leaving the field due to discomfort in his arm. His return before halftime brought relief to the Chiefs, although footage of his medical evaluation raised concerns.
articles.summary: The Kansas City quarterback set off alarm bells after briefly leaving the field due to discomfort in his arm. His return before halftime brought relief to the Chiefs, although footage of his medical evaluation raised concerns.
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes was at the center of one of the most tense moments for the Kansas City Chiefs during the game. The quarterback had to leave the field after feeling discomfort in his arm and spent several minutes with the medical staff, while uncertainty grew about whether he would be able to continue playing.

The footage did not go unnoticed: Mahomes took off his helmet on the sideline and was examined by doctors, his expressions of pain raising fears of the worst. During those minutes, the possibility that he might not be able to return to the game set off alarm bells at Arrowhead.

Patrick Mahomes Raises Concerns Among the Chiefs After Taking a Hard Hit to the Arm

Concerns grew because this wasn’t a passing discomfort that could be ignored. The hit came after a sack by defensive end David Bailey, which left Mahomes on the ground and the ball loose. As head coach Andy Reid told CBS, the quarterback was experiencing elbow pain and was being evaluated.

However, the news the Chiefs needed to hear came before halftime: Mahomes returned to the field and was able to continue leading the offense. His return gave Kansas City a sigh of relief, as they headed into the locker room with a 14-12 l ead over the New York Jets.

Now, all eyes will be on how the quarterback’s arm holds up in the second half. Although his return was a positive sign , the discomfort in his elbow leaves a question mark hanging over the Chiefs in a game where they cannot afford to lose their star player.

articles.title: Travis Kelce disagrees with Brittany Mahomes over take on play against the Broncos: What will Patrick Mahomes think?
articles.standfirst: A controversial false start has sparked differing opinions within Kansas City
articles.summary: A controversial false start has sparked differing opinions within Kansas City
articles.body:
Travis Kelce has offered a very different interpretation of the penalty that denied the Kansas City Chiefs a dramatic victory over the Denver Broncos , publicly contradicting Brittany Mahomes ' criticism of the officials while insisting his teammates should have handled the setback better.

The Chiefs appeared to have completed a remarkable comeback during their November 1 meeting with Denver when Patrick Mahomes found Rashee Rice in the end zone in the closing seconds.

However, the celebrations were immediately interrupted when officials penalized offensive tackle Jaylon Moore for a false start, wiping out the touchdown and leaving Kansas City needing another successful play.

The Broncos subsequently secured a 28-24 victory when Malcolm Roach sacked Mahomes on the final snap, leaving the Chiefs frustrated by a decision that had transformed the outcome.

Brittany , watching her husband's team lose in dramatic circumstances, made her feelings clear on Instagram shortly afterward.

"You can't tell me you call that on a game winning TD," she wrote. "Oh wait yeah I can cause it's us."

She subsequently described the decision as "the weakest call I have ever seen," suggesting the officials had been unnecessarily harsh on Kansas City.

While Brittany questioned whether the penalty should have been called, Kelce offered a notably different assessment during an appearance on the New Heights podcast.

Discussing the incident with his brother Jason , the Chiefs tight end acknowledged that Moore had moved illegally before the snap.

"A lot of people are saying this wasn't a penalty; I'm going to go on record and say that this is definitely a penalty," Jason said.

Travis immediately supported his brother's conclusion, replying: "Yeah, he flinches."

However, the three-time Super Bowl champion appeared more concerned about how the Chiefs responded after the flag than whether officials were justified in throwing it.

"At the end of the day, we still had another play," Travis explained. "I'll take my guy Pat Mahomes on the six-yard line with the game on the line."

He added: "We can't let the penalty absolutely deflate us and not let us execute at the end of the game."

Patrick Mahomes also questioned the call

Kelce 's interpretation differed not only from Brittany's reaction but also from the initial assessment offered by Mahomes himself.

The Chiefs quarterback admitted afterward that he had not noticed significant movement from Moore before the snap, although he acknowledged that the officials' decision was final.

"It couldn't have been big, but it was called," Mahomes told reporters.

Head coach Andy Reid also questioned the decision, explaining that he saw Moore move his head but didn't believe the action warranted a false start.

However, Kelce 's comments suggest that he believes Kansas City's inability to execute on the following play was equally important in determining the result.

With Kansas City looking to recover against the New York Jets , Kelce 's message was ultimately about accountability rather than officiating, emphasizing that championship contenders must overcome setbacks instead of allowing one penalty to decide their fate.

articles.title: NFL in shock after Patrick Mahomes injures his right arm… but he's back in the game!
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City quarterback appeared in serious discomfort after a brutal hit against the Jets
articles.summary: The Kansas City quarterback appeared in serious discomfort after a brutal hit against the Jets
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes appeared to be facing another potentially serious injury setback on Sunday when a crushing hit against the New York Jets left the Kansas City Chiefs quarterback in visible pain and struggling to move his throwing arm.

The three-time Super Bowl champion had been attempting to extend Kansas City's narrow lead late in the second quarter when Jets rookie David Bailey broke through the offensive line and struck his right arm as he prepared to release a deep pass.

Mahomes immediately lost possession, with Will McDonald recovering the fumble at the Chiefs ' 30-yard line as New York threatened to overturn a 14-12 deficit before halftime.

However, attention quickly shifted from the turnover to the quarterback's condition as he remained on the ground, pulling his right arm toward his chest before slowly getting back to his feet.

The 31-year-old appeared uncomfortable as teammates escorted him toward the sideline, with his arm hanging by his side while Kansas City's medical staff prepared to assess the damage.

The incident raised immediate concerns because the contact involved Mahomes ' throwing arm, an injury that could have significant consequences for Kansas City's ambitions this season.

Bailey had beaten right tackle Jaylon Moore around the edge before reaching Mahomes , recording his second sack of the afternoon and continuing an impressive rookie campaign.

Once on the sideline, Mahomes began cautiously testing his arm with practice throws while speaking to members of the medical team.

Meanwhile, the Chiefs ' defense prevented New York from capitalizing on the turnover, with Chris Jones recording a sack before Jason Sanders missed a field goal.

The defensive stand gave Mahomes another opportunity to enter the game, and the quarterback returned for Kansas City's next offensive possession without missing a snap.

He immediately completed a 12-yard pass to Travis Kelce before scrambling seven yards, demonstrating that he remained capable of operating the offense despite the earlier discomfort.

Reid addresses Patrick Mahomes' elbow injury

Chiefs head coach Andy Reid confirmed during the CBS broadcast that Mahomes had hurt his elbow and was experiencing soreness, although he praised the quarterback's toughness.

His return offered considerable reassurance, particularly after the quarterback's previous ACL injury had already created challenges for Kansas City.

However, the final moments of the first half brought another setback when Harrison Butker missed two consecutive opportunities to extend the Chiefs ' advantage.

Butker initially sent a 56-yard field goal wide right, but an offside penalty against New York gave him another attempt from 51 yards.

The veteran kicker missed again, leaving Kansas City leading 14-12 at halftime despite two touchdown passes from Mahomes to running back Kenneth Walker III .

The quarterback had accumulated 120 passing yards and two touchdowns before the interval, maintaining the Chiefs ' narrow advantage despite the turnover and injury scare.

Although Mahomes ' ability to return was encouraging, the extent of the discomfort in his right elbow remained uncertain, making his condition an important storyline throughout the remainder of the contest.

Kansas City avoided an immediate quarterback crisis, but the frightening collision demonstrated how quickly its playoff ambitions could be threatened by an injury to its most important player.

articles.title: Harrison Butker misses two nearly identical kicks as Chiefs fans turn on kicker
articles.standfirst: The sequence was difficult to believe for a player that's been on the hot seat for a few weeks
articles.summary: The sequence was difficult to believe for a player that's been on the hot seat for a few weeks
articles.body:
H arrison Butker could hardly have had a more frustrating sequence. The Kansas City Chiefs kicker missed two consecutive attempts from almost the same spot Sunday against the New York Jets, sending the Arrowhead Stadium crowd into a chorus of boos as the teams headed into halftime.

Butker initially lined up for a 56-yard field goal with Kansas City looking to extend its lead. The kick sailed wide right, denying the Chiefs an opportunity to add three points to their advantage. Then came an unexpected second chance.

The Jets were penalized for being offside, giving Butker another opportunity from five yards closer. Instead of correcting his aim, the veteran kicker produced an almost identical result: another miss wide right.

The misses were particularly concerning

The sequence was difficult to believe. Butker missed from 56 yards and then failed again from 51, with both attempts going wide to the right. The back-to-back misses quickly became a talking point among NFL fans, while the home crowd made its displeasure clear.

Chiefs supporters loudly booed Butker as he left the field, a striking reaction for a kicker who has been an important part of Kansas City’s success during its championship years.

The misses were particularly concerning given Butker’s struggles throughout the 2026 season. Kansas City decided to keep him as its starting kicker despite his declining accuracy, with head coach Andy Reid confirming Wednesday that the veteran would remain active for the matchup against New York.

Butke r entered Sunday’s game having converted just 12 of 18 field-goal attempts, a 66.7% success rate that ranked near the bottom of the league among qualifying kickers. His problems have been especially noticeable from long distance: he had made only two of seven attempts from 50 yards or beyond.

A recent troubled history

His recent history from that range has also been troubling. Including the postseason, Butker had converted only nine of 20 field-goal attempts from at least 50 yards since the beginning of the 2024 season. From 2020 through 2023, he had made 25 of 32 such attempts.

That decline helps explain why Kansas City recently added former All-Pro kicker Justin Tucker to its practice squad. The move raised questions about Butker’s future , although the Chiefs opted to give their longtime kicker another opportunity against the Jets.

Sunday’s sequence did little to quiet those concerns. The Chiefs entered halftime with a narrow 14-12 lead, but the two missed opportunities left fans frustrated and put additional attention on a position that has become an unexpected problem for a team with championship ambitions.

articles.title: Chiefs run trick play without Patrick Mahomes and immediately suffer embarrassing turnover!
articles.standfirst: Andy Reid introduced Justin Fields for a rare quarterback sneak against the Jets
articles.summary: Andy Reid introduced Justin Fields for a rare quarterback sneak against the Jets
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs finally answered calls to bring back the quarterback sneak on Sunday, but their first attempt in more than three years produced exactly the kind of mistake Andy Reid could ill afford.

Facing the New York Jets at Arrowhead Stadium, Kansas City introduced backup quarterback Justin Fields for a third-and-one situation midway through the opening quarter, with Patrick Mahomes moving into the backfield.

The formation was designed to exploit Fields ' athleticism while keeping Mahomes away from the physical demands of a quarterback sneak, a play the Chiefs have largely avoided since their franchise quarterback suffered a serious knee injury in 2019.

However, the unusual approach immediately backfired when Fields mishandled the snap, losing possession as he attempted to drive forward for the first down.

Officials initially ruled the backup quarterback down, but a replay review determined that New York had recovered the football, handing the Jets possession deep inside Kansas City territory.

The visitors subsequently converted the turnover into a field goal, adding to the frustration surrounding an offense already under scrutiny for its difficulties in short-yardage situations.

Kansas City's decision followed a week of criticism after the Chiefs failed to convert crucial opportunities near the goal line during their 28-24 defeat against Denver.

Running back Kenneth Walker III was stopped short on third down before a potential winning touchdown was erased by a false start penalty against offensive tackle Jaylon Moore .

Mahomes was subsequently sacked on the game's final play, prompting questions about why Kansas City had refused to use a conventional quarterback sneak.

The Chiefs have rarely employed the play since Mahomes dislocated his kneecap while attempting one against Denver in October 2019.

However, the quarterback insisted before Sunday's meeting that he would willingly take on the responsibility if Reid believed it would help Kansas City win.

"I'm going to do whatever it takes to win," Mahomes said. "At the end of the day, quarterback sneak, whatever that is, I'll do whatever it takes."

articles.title: Travis Kelce's look of concern when Patrick Mahomes went down sums up the pain felt by all the Chiefs
articles.standfirst: Cameras captured an emotional reaction from the Chiefs star after Mahomes clutched his throwing arm
articles.summary: Cameras captured an emotional reaction from the Chiefs star after Mahomes clutched his throwing arm
articles.body:
Travis Kelce has shared some of the greatest moments of his NFL career with Patrick Mahomes , but the Kansas City Chiefs tight end could do little more than watch anxiously when his quarterback suffered a painful injury against the New York Jets .

The three-time Super Bowl champion was visibly shaken after Mahomes took a heavy hit late in the second quarter at Arrowhead Stadium, with television cameras capturing Kelce looking toward the sky and closing his eyes in apparent frustration.

The incident occurred when Jets rookie edge rusher David Bailey beat Kansas City's protection and struck Mahomes ' right arm as the quarterback attempted to launch a deep pass.

Mahomes lost possession on the play, allowing New York to recover the football in Chiefs territory, but the turnover quickly became secondary to concerns about his physical condition.

The quarterback remained on the ground clutching his right elbow before slowly walking toward the sideline, where Kansas City's medical staff immediately began examining his throwing arm.

With Mahomes having already overcome a serious knee injury sustained last season, the sight of another potentially significant setback understandably raised concerns throughout the Chiefs organization.

Kelce 's reaction highlighted the importance of Mahomes to Kansas City's championship ambitions, particularly following an injury that required extensive rehabilitation before the 2026 season.

Mahomes appeared uncomfortable while testing his arm on the sideline, carefully throwing passes as medical personnel assessed whether he could continue.

However, the quarterback returned for Kansas City's next offensive possession without missing a snap, immediately completing a 12-yard pass to Kelce .

He then scrambled seven yards to set up a field goal opportunity, although Harrison Butker missed twice after an offside penalty gave him a second attempt.

Kansas City entered halftime leading 14-12, with head coach Andy Reid offering a reassuring assessment during an interview with CBS reporter Tracy Wolfson .

"He hurt his elbow a little bit," Reid said. "It's sore, but he came back. He's a tough kid."

Mahomes and Kelce turn injury scare into touchdown

The second half provided an encouraging response as Mahomes returned to lead another scoring drive, demonstrating that the injury had not prevented him from directing the offense.

After the quarterback was stopped near the goal line, Reid kept his offense on the field for fourth down, trusting his two most experienced playmakers to finish the drive.

Mahomes delivered a short lateral to Kelce , who powered into the end zone for a touchdown that extended Kansas City's advantage to 21-12.

Although the exchange resembled a short pass, the play was officially recorded as a rushing touchdown, Kelce 's third of his NFL career.

The Chiefs eventually secured a 35-12 victory, with Mahomes completing 23 of 31 passes for 242 yards as Kansas City ended its two-game losing streak.

Kelce had previously praised Mahomes ' determination during his rehabilitation, explaining how their partnership continued to motivate him late in his own career.

While Mahomes ' ability to finish the game offered considerable reassurance, the Chiefs will still need to monitor his elbow as they prepare for their next challenge.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes’ own update of elbow injury doesn’t inspire confidence: “Didn’t feel great”
articles.standfirst: Mahomes was able to come back into the game between the Kansas City Chiefs and New York Jets, but Week 10 could be a whole different story.
articles.summary: Mahomes was able to come back into the game between the Kansas City Chiefs and New York Jets, but Week 10 could be a whole different story.
articles.body:
Week 9 provided the perfect bounce back opportunity for the Kansas City Chiefs . After two straight losses, the Chiefs were back at home to host the spiraling New York Jets . The Chiefs easily took care of business.

A second half onslaught saw the Chiefs finish with a 35-12 victory. It wasn’t all sunshine and roses, as Harrison Butker missed yet another field goal, and Patrick Mahomes went down at one point with an arm injury that raised every possible alarm. Despite seemingly being in immense pain, Mahomes ended up going back in and finished the game .

While that eased concern among the fanbase, there’s still potential of an absence for Mahomes going forward. There’s still no official diagnosis of Mahomes’ injury, but it’s being classified as an elbow issue . Mahomes himself was the one who gave an update following the game, admitting that his status for next week is going to depend on how his elbow responds to treatment.

Patrick Mahomes isn't sure about his status going forward with elbow injury

Mahomes said that it “ didn’t feel great ” in the moment, and that coming out of halftime he “ wasn’t throwing the ball the way I wanted to ”. After working on it with trainers, he felt a bit more comfortable as the game went on . But he will probably have to deal with pain and swelling, as soon as tomorrow.

So, we’re gonna go do some testing here whenever I get done with this media stuff right here, and we’ll get a better understanding of it. I’m sure Coach Reid will give you an update tomorrow… And so that’ll be important this week, is kind of getting that the swelling and the fluid out of it, so I can be ready to go from the first snap next week. I feel good now. I mean, obviously, get the win, and the adrenaline’s pumping. I’m sure I’ll be sore tomorrow, but we’ll get right to it. You know, we’ll get to work on it.

Mahomes is always optimistic when it comes to being able to play injured, but the Chiefs will likely take precaution if there’s a high risk of re-injury next week. They play against the Atlanta Falcons and Arizona Cardinals over the next two weeks, so they would still be in a decent position to win those games if Mahomes has to miss them.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs breathe huge sigh of relief as MRI results come back
articles.standfirst: Mahomes could still potentially miss some time, but a worst case scenario has been avoided.
articles.summary: Mahomes could still potentially miss some time, but a worst case scenario has been avoided.
articles.body:
The entire fanbase of the Kansas City Chiefs held its collective breath for more than just a moment during the team’s win over the New York Jets . While attempting a pass, Patrick Mahomes got his right throwing arm bent back in an awkward manner.

The sight of Mahomes grabbing his dangling arm, writhing in pain, was enough for Chiefs fans to expect the absolute worst. But as Mahomes has done so many times in his NFL career, he found a way to fight through the pain and come back into the game . He actually was able to play out the whole game, which ended in a 35-12 victory for Kansas City.

The attention now turns to Mahomes’ elbow injury, which is yet to be properly diagnosed as anything other than that. Mahomes himself, when addressing the injury during his postgame press conference, said that he will have to see how much pain and swelling he has as the week progresses . Before any of that, an MRI was needed to determine the extent of the injury.

Patrick Mahomes avoided major elbow injury, but pain and swelling will have to be monitored

The MRI results have come back quickly, and Chiefs fans can breathe a big sigh of relief. According to Ian Rapoport , “ the tests did not reveal a major injury ”. Rapoport does note that his injury will be monitored over the next few days, so Mahomes isn’t completely out of the clear yet .

Given the adrenaline of the game taking over to mask his pain in the moment, Mahomes will likely be quite sore on Monday morning . Making the injury tricky is that it’s on his throwing arm. If Mahomes feels he can’t properly execute every throw needed within the Chiefs offense, he probably won’t be out there in Week 10. Only time will tell.

articles.title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce enjoy a luxury exit from Arrowhead after Chiefs' dominant win
articles.standfirst: Week 9.
articles.summary: Week 9.
articles.body:
Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce left Arrowhead Stadium in a way that caught everyone's attention: riding in a classic cream-colored Cadillac . The Chiefs tight end got behind the wheel while the singer took the passenger seat, wearing the red-and-pink striped knit polo she had chosen to support him during the game.

It was a stylish ending to a day that went very well for Kansas City.

The Chiefs found the perfect opponent in the Jets to turn things around after two consecutive losses. Kansas City dominated the matchup, securing a 35-12 victory, although there was a moment of concern for its fans. Patrick Mahomes raised alarm bells after taking a hard hit to his throwing arm following a sack, but he was able to return to the field and finished with 242 passing yards and two touchdowns.

Kenneth Walker III also had an outstanding afternoon, scoring three touchdowns, two receiving and one rushing. His contributions helped Kansas City extend its lead, while Kelce got on the scoreboard with a one-yard rushing touchdown. The tight end finished the game with 72 receiving yards on four catches.

However, the Chiefs won't have much time to celebrate. Their next challenge comes Sunday, November 15, when they travel to Georgia to face the Atlanta Falcons at Mercedes-Benz Stadium .
