articles.title: Harrison Butker's future at the Chiefs looks dark after Andy Reid was on the verge of making a definitive decision
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City kicker's latest failure has intensified the competition for his job, with Justin Tucker waiting for an opportunity after joining the practice squad
articles.summary: The Kansas City kicker's latest failure has intensified the competition for his job, with Justin Tucker waiting for an opportunity after joining the practice squad
articles.body:
H arrison Butker 's position with the Kansas City Chiefs is becoming increasingly difficult to defend after another disappointing performance against the New York Jets .

Although Kansas City celebrated a convincing 35-12 victory in Week 9, the kicking situation has become a significant concern, and head coach Andy Reid is no longer offering the same reassurance about his veteran specialist.

Butker missed a field goal from 51 yards just before halftime at Arrowhead Stadium on Sunday, prompting boos from sections of the home crowd. The attempt was particularly frustrating because it came after he had already missed from 56 yards.

A penalty against the Jets gave him another opportunity from five yards closer, but he failed to convert that attempt as well. Only the second miss counted in the official statistics.

Reid had previously indicated that Butker would remain the team's kicker ahead of the Jets game. However, his response after Sunday's contest suggested that the situation could now change.

"I'm sure I'll be asked about Butker ," Reid told reporters. "I'll address that as we go throughout the week. I'll look at everything and... no need to ask. That'll be the answer that you get. I'm not making any decisions right now today."

The coach's refusal to offer immediate backing represents a notable shift from his earlier position. With Kansas City preparing for its next game against the Atlanta Falcons , Butker could be facing a crucial week as the organization considers whether to continue trusting him.

Justin Tucker's arrival gives the Chiefs another option

The timing of Butker's struggles is particularly significant because Kansas City has already brought in an experienced alternative. The Chiefs signed Justin Tucker to their practice squad in late October, creating competition for a position that had previously appeared secure.

Tucker built a reputation as one of the NFL's most reliable kickers during his time with the Baltimore Ravens .

He earned seven Pro Bowl selections and became the league's career leader in field-goal percentage, making his availability an intriguing possibility for the Chiefs.

However, his potential promotion also comes with complications. Tucker faced multiple allegations of sexual misconduct in 2025, which he denied, and received a 10-game suspension. Any decision to put him on the active roster would therefore attract attention beyond his performances on the field.

Butker's own numbers explain why the Chiefs are considering alternatives. He has converted just 12 of 19 field-goal attempts this season, giving him a success rate of 63.2%. He has also missed an extra point, taking his total number of missed kicks to eight.

That represents a dramatic decline from his 86.8% field-goal accuracy in 2025.

Despite the problems, Butker has insisted that he remains confident.

"I try to be my best on every single kick, and unfortunately, those 50-plus-yarders aren't going in," he said after the Jets game. "But I feel confident. I'm excited for the kicks, and I just have to do better."

He also acknowledged that he did not have an immediate explanation for the misses, saying, "I wish I knew, and then I would make them go in."

The Chiefs have important decisions ahead as they attempt to remain competitive in the AFC. Butker has spent 10 seasons in Kansas City and played an important role in the franchise's championship success, so replacing him would not be an insignificant move.

Nevertheless, his history cannot erase the problems of the present. With Tucker waiting and Reid promising to review the situation, Butker's starting position is facing its most serious challenge in years.

Whether he gets another opportunity against Atlanta could depend on what the coaching staff sees during the coming week.

articles.title: Travis Kelce's 'modest' first home in Briarcliff West has a very exciting history behind his current claims
articles.standfirst: Long before purchasing multimillion-dollar estates in Kansas and Ohio, the Kansas City Chiefs star invested in a property that marked an important step in his financial journey
articles.summary: Long before purchasing multimillion-dollar estates in Kansas and Ohio, the Kansas City Chiefs star invested in a property that marked an important step in his financial journey
articles.body:
T ravis Kelce 's property portfolio has grown considerably alongside his success in the NFL , but one of his most interesting real estate purchases came before he became a household name outside football.

In 2019, the Kansas City Chiefs tight end paid $995,000 for a home in the Briarcliff West neighborhood of Kansas City, Missouri, making it his first major residential investment in the area.

Describing the property as modest is relative, considering its price and facilities. However, compared with the multimillion-dollar estates he has acquired since, it represents a very different chapter of his life.

The house was reportedly built in 1994 and underwent substantial renovations in 2007. Its size has been described differently by various publications, with estimates ranging from approximately 4,200 to 10,000 square feet.

The property has also been reported to feature as many as seven bedrooms and several bathrooms.

Inside, the residence offered plenty of space for an NFL player looking for somewhere to relax away from the demands of professional football. Reported features include a gourmet kitchen, a recreation room, a private gym and a wine cellar with a built-in bar.

The outdoor area was another attraction, with a swimming pool, gazebo and space for entertaining. The home also had a distinctive interior style, including warm wood cabinetry, granite countertops and decorative details that reflected the renovation era.

It was an impressive purchase for a player who had already established himself as one of the NFL's leading tight ends, but Kelce's career and public profile would soon reach another level.

From Briarcliff West to multimillion-dollar estates

Kelce's first Kansas City home became part of a wider property story as his earnings and fame increased.

In 2023, he purchased a much larger residence in Leawood, Kansas, for approximately $6 million. The property reportedly measures around 17,000 square feet and sits on nearly 3.5 acres inside a gated community.

The estate offers considerably more privacy than the Briarcliff West property, with a six-bedroom layout, a chef's kitchen, a media lounge, a wine cellar, a swimming pool and outdoor recreational facilities.

It also became an important location in his personal life: Kelce proposed to Taylor Swift at the property in 2025.

His real estate portfolio expanded again in 2026 when he purchased a historic lakefront property in Bratenahl, Ohio, for $5.35 million.

The estate, which sits on approximately 3.5 acres along Lake Erie, is particularly significant because it is close to Cleveland Heights, where Kelce grew up with his older brother, Jason.

Built in 1895, the approximately 21,000-square-foot residence has eight bedrooms and 11 bathrooms.

Its features include a former ballroom converted into a game room and home theater, a swimming pool, a five-car garage and a separate guest cottage created from the property's former gatehouse.

A home from before the Taylor Swift spotlight

The Briarcliff West purchase is interesting because it belongs to a period when Kelce was already successful but had not yet become a global celebrity through his relationship with Swift .

He joined the Chiefs in 2013 and gradually developed into one of the NFL's most productive tight ends. His success on the field helped establish the financial foundation for his property investments, while his growing popularity eventually opened opportunities beyond football.

His off-field profile also expanded through New Heights, the podcast he launched with Jason in 2022. The show gives the brothers an opportunity to discuss football, family and popular culture, helping them connect with audiences beyond their respective NFL careers.

The Briarcliff West property therefore represents more than an earlier, less expensive address. It reflects the stage of Kelce's life when he was building his career, investing in his future and establishing himself in Kansas City.

Whether he still owns the residence has not been clearly confirmed in recent reporting. Nevertheless, its place in his property history remains significant.

From a $995,000 Kansas City purchase to a $5.35 million historic Ohio estate, Kelce's real estate journey offers another illustration of how dramatically his life has changed since arriving in the NFL.
paragraphs: T ravis Kelce 's property portfolio has grown considerably alongside his success in the NFL , but one of his most interesting real estate purchases came before he became a household name outside football.
In 2019, the Kansas City Chiefs tight end paid $995,000 for a home in the Briarcliff West neighborhood of Kansas City, Missouri, making it his first major residential investment in the area.

Describing the property as modest is relative, considering its price and facilities. However, compared with the multimillion-dollar estates he has acquired since, it represents a very different chapter of his life.

The house was reportedly built in 1994 and underwent substantial renovations in 2007. Its size has been described differently by various publications, with estimates ranging from approximately 4,200 to 10,000 square feet.
The property has also been reported to feature as many as seven bedrooms and several bathrooms.

Inside, the residence offered plenty of space for an NFL player looking for somewhere to relax away from the demands of professional football. Reported features include a gourmet kitchen, a recreation room, a private gym and a wine cellar with a built-in bar.

The outdoor area was another attraction, with a swimming pool, gazebo and space for entertaining. The home also had a distinctive interior style, including warm wood cabinetry, granite countertops and decorative details that reflected the renovation era.
It was an impressive purchase for a player who had already established himself as one of the NFL's leading tight ends, but Kelce's career and public profile would soon reach another level.
From Briarcliff West to multimillion-dollar estates
Kelce's first Kansas City home became part of a wider property story as his earnings and fame increased.

In 2023, he purchased a much larger residence in Leawood, Kansas, for approximately $6 million. The property reportedly measures around 17,000 square feet and sits on nearly 3.5 acres inside a gated community.

The estate offers considerably more privacy than the Briarcliff West property, with a six-bedroom layout, a chef's kitchen, a media lounge, a wine cellar, a swimming pool and outdoor recreational facilities.
It also became an important location in his personal life: Kelce proposed to Taylor Swift at the property in 2025.
His real estate portfolio expanded again in 2026 when he purchased a historic lakefront property in Bratenahl, Ohio, for $5.35 million.
The estate, which sits on approximately 3.5 acres along Lake Erie, is particularly significant because it is close to Cleveland Heights, where Kelce grew up with his older brother, Jason.
Built in 1895, the approximately 21,000-square-foot residence has eight bedrooms and 11 bathrooms.
Its features include a former ballroom converted into a game room and home theater, a swimming pool, a five-car garage and a separate guest cottage created from the property's former gatehouse.
A home from before the Taylor Swift spotlight
The Briarcliff West purchase is interesting because it belongs to a period when Kelce was already successful but had not yet become a global celebrity through his relationship with Swift .

He joined the Chiefs in 2013 and gradually developed into one of the NFL's most productive tight ends. His success on the field helped establish the financial foundation for his property investments, while his growing popularity eventually opened opportunities beyond football.

His off-field profile also expanded through New Heights, the podcast he launched with Jason in 2022. The show gives the brothers an opportunity to discuss football, family and popular culture, helping them connect with audiences beyond their respective NFL careers.

The Briarcliff West property therefore represents more than an earlier, less expensive address. It reflects the stage of Kelce's life when he was building his career, investing in his future and establishing himself in Kansas City.
Whether he still owns the residence has not been clearly confirmed in recent reporting. Nevertheless, its place in his property history remains significant.

From a $995,000 Kansas City purchase to a $5.35 million historic Ohio estate, Kelce's real estate journey offers another illustration of how dramatically his life has changed since arriving in the NFL.

articles.title: The latest update on Tyreek Hill's health status may end his hopes of returning to the Chiefs
articles.standfirst: The former Kansas City star remains a free agent as he works his way back from a devastating knee injury, but a new report suggests he still cannot pass the physical required to return to the NFL
articles.summary: The former Kansas City star remains a free agent as he works his way back from a devastating knee injury, but a new report suggests he still cannot pass the physical required to return to the NFL
articles.body:
T yreek Hill 's long-awaited return to the NFL is facing another significant obstacle, with his physical condition reportedly still preventing him from signing with a team.

That development could also damage hopes of a reunion with the Kansas City Chiefs , who have been linked with their former wide receiver as they look for ways to strengthen their offense.

Hill has been out of action since suffering a serious left knee injury during the Miami Dolphins ' game against the New York Jets on September 29, 2025.

The injury involved a dislocated knee and extensive ligament damage, including a torn ACL, requiring surgery and a lengthy rehabilitation process.

Now 32, the eight-time Pro Bowl selection has spent months trying to regain the strength and explosiveness that made him one of the NFL's most dangerous offensive weapons.

However, Kansas City reporter Pete Sweeney has provided a concerning indication of where that recovery stands.

Speaking with Trey Wingo , Sweeney explained that the Chiefs would explore different possibilities to improve their receiving options, but Hill might not yet be physically ready to contribute.

"We had kind of heard locally that Tyreek Hill wouldn't really be ready to pass a physical, take the field until early to mid November," Sweeney said.

That timeframe is particularly relevant because November has arrived without Hill securing a contract. Although the report does not rule out a comeback later in the season, it suggests that any team interested in signing him would first need reassurance that his knee can withstand the demands of professional football.

The Chiefs reunion is becoming increasingly complicated

Kansas City supporters have reason to be interested in the possibility of Hill returning. He spent the first six seasons of his NFL career with the Chiefs after being selected in the fifth round of the 2016 draft.

During that period, he developed into one of Patrick Mahomes ' favorite targets and helped Kansas City win Super Bowl LIV. Hill recorded 479 receptions for 6,630 yards and 56 receiving touchdowns during his Chiefs career, establishing himself as one of the most explosive players in the league.

The Chiefs eventually traded him to Miami in 2022 after the two sides could not agree on a long-term contract.

His departure did not prevent him from maintaining an elite level of production, including a remarkable 2023 season in which he led the NFL with 1,799 receiving yards and 13 touchdowns.

His return would therefore offer Kansas City a familiar weapon with a proven connection to Mahomes . However, the organization would need to be confident that he could still produce at that level.

Sweeney also raised another consideration beyond Hill's physical condition: "It's the type of player as well that it's 'do we want to bring this player into the locker room?' Just considering some of the off-the-field stuff, but at a certain point, the Chiefs showed us two weeks ago the off-the-field to them maybe doesn't matter."

The comments refer to the questions surrounding Hill's personal life, which could complicate any potential move.

In October 2026, a civil jury found him liable on two battery claims involving his estranged wife, awarding her $500,000 in compensatory damages. The verdict was a civil finding, not a criminal conviction, but it could still be relevant to an NFL team's evaluation under the league's personal conduct policy.

What has Hill said about his recovery?

Hill has previously been candid about how difficult rehabilitation has been. In July, approximately 10 months after undergoing two operations, he revealed that he was still struggling to regain strength in his injured leg.

"So it's about 10 months after doing two surgeries," Hill explained in a rehabilitation video. "My left leg is the one that I injured. I have no power in my left leg at all, so I'm trying to regain all the power back in my left leg. But it's one day at a time."

His agent, Drew Rosenhaus , has remained optimistic, saying in October that Hill was close to full recovery. He also confirmed that conversations had taken place with multiple teams, although he stressed that no agreement was imminent.

It was also reported that Hill had traveled to Germany for specialized treatment as he continued working toward a return.

For now, there is no confirmed signing, no official comeback date and no guarantee that Kansas City will pursue the reunion. Hill's previous achievements make him an attractive name, but his health remains the biggest question.

Until he can pass a physical and demonstrate that he is ready to play, the possibility of seeing him back alongside Mahomes will remain uncertain.

articles.title: J.J. Watt slams Andy Reid for not being bold with Justin Tucker: “I don’t know why you bring him in”
articles.standfirst: Kansas City's decision to keep Tucker on the practice squad has come under renewed scrutiny
articles.summary: Kansas City's decision to keep Tucker on the practice squad has come under renewed scrutiny
articles.body:
J.J. Watt believes the Kansas City Chiefs have created an unnecessary problem for themselves by bringing Justin Tucker into the organization without making a change at kicker, especially as Harrison Butker continues to struggle with his accuracy.

The three-time NFL Defensive Player of the Year questioned Andy Reid 's decision-making during Sunday's 35-12 victory over the New York Jets , when another difficult afternoon for Butker overshadowed an otherwise convincing performance.

Kansas City's veteran kicker missed two field goal attempts in the closing seconds of the first half, prompting boos from the Arrowhead Stadium crowd and renewed questions about his position.

Butker initially sent a 56-yard attempt wide right, only to receive another opportunity after New York was penalized for defensive offside.

However, the reprieve proved meaningless when he pushed the subsequent 51-yard attempt wide in the same direction, leaving the Chiefs without additional points before halftime.

With Tucker still on the practice squad, Watt questioned why Kansas City had accepted the controversy surrounding his signing without subsequently using him.

"We talked about it last week ad nauseam, the distraction of bringing him in and the allegations and everything," Watt said during the CBS broadcast.

"I don't know why you bring him in and invite those distractions if you're not going to make that change."

The former Houston Texans defensive star was referring to Kansas City's decision to sign Tucker in October as Butker 's performances became increasingly inconsistent.

Tucker , who spent 13 seasons with the Baltimore Ravens , was accused of sexual misconduct by 16 massage therapists in the Baltimore area.

He has denied the allegations and was not criminally charged, although the NFL suspended him for 10 games under its personal conduct policy.

His arrival in Kansas City attracted criticism, particularly from organizations representing survivors of sexual misconduct, raising questions about the franchise's willingness to accept the associated scrutiny.

Watt 's comments highlighted the apparent contradiction between making such a controversial signing and continuing to rely exclusively on Butker .

Andy Reid refuses to make immediate decision

Butker has now converted 12 of his 19 field goal attempts this season, leaving him with a 63.2 percent success rate as Kansas City approaches the second half of its campaign.

The veteran acknowledged his difficulties after Sunday's victory but insisted he remains confident in his ability to rediscover his previous form.

"I try to be my best on every single kick, and unfortunately, those 50-plus-yarders aren't going in," Butker told reporters. "But I feel confident. I'm excited for the kicks, and I just have to do better."

Reid declined to announce any immediate changes, suggesting the coaching staff would review the situation before making a decision.

"I'll address that as we go throughout the week," Reid said. "I'll look at everything. I'm not making any decisions right now today."

Butker 's history with the Chiefs includes three Super Bowl championships, making any decision to replace him particularly significant.

However, with Tucker already available as an alternative and Kansas City's kicking problems remaining unresolved, Reid faces increasing pressure to explain how he intends to address the position.

articles.title: Andy Reid reveals Patrick Mahomes injury verdict as Chiefs face nervous wait before Falcons game
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City quarterback underwent medical tests after hurting his throwing elbow against the Jets
articles.summary: The Kansas City quarterback underwent medical tests after hurting his throwing elbow against the Jets
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs emerged from Sunday's convincing victory over the New York Jets with another important win, but the condition of Patrick Mahomes quickly became the biggest concern surrounding Andy Reid 's team.

Mahomes suffered a painful injury to his throwing elbow during the 35-12 triumph at Arrowhead Stadium, briefly raising fears that Kansas City could lose its franchise quarterback at a crucial stage of the season.

Although the three-time Super Bowl champion managed to finish the game, questions remained about whether the injury would affect his availability for Sunday's trip to face the Atlanta Falcons .

Reid provided some reassurance Monday, revealing that the initial medical assessment had been encouraging and that Mahomes was receiving treatment at the team's training facility.

"It was more positive news than negative news on Patrick," Reid told reporters during his Monday news conference.

"It looks like it's just a matter of some rehab in there and getting rid of some of the soreness. We'll just see where it goes from there."

However, the Chiefs coach confirmed that Mahomes remains day to day, leaving his participation in this week's practices uncertain.

The concerning incident occurred late in the second quarter when Jets rookie defensive end David Bailey struck Mahomes ' right arm as he attempted to release a pass.

The collision forced a fumble and left the quarterback clutching his elbow on the ground before Kansas City's medical staff examined him.

Mahomes subsequently tested his throwing motion on the sideline and returned to action without missing an offensive snap, eventually completing 23 of 31 passes for 242 yards and two touchdowns.

An MRI conducted after the game reportedly revealed no major structural damage, providing further encouragement following an incident that initially appeared considerably more serious.

Mahomes acknowledged the frightening nature of the collision but explained that he was determined to continue once the discomfort became manageable.

"If I'm able to play, I'm going to play," Mahomes said after Sunday's victory. "That's part of the game. It scares you in moments, when you get some pains in certain areas of your body."

Reid faces important Mahomes decision

Despite the encouraging medical news, Reid remains reluctant to make predictions about how much practice Mahomes will complete before Kansas City's next game.

"We'll see where he's at Wednesday," Reid explained. "He feels pretty good today. He's sore, but I'm glad we're not practicing today."

The Chiefs are also dealing with injuries to wide receiver Xavier Worthy and right tackle Jaylon Moore , who sustained hamstring and ankle problems respectively against New York.

Both players have also been classified as day to day, potentially complicating preparations for a team already managing several injury concerns.

Should Mahomes be unable to play, Justin Fields would provide Kansas City with an experienced alternative, although Reid has given no indication that a quarterback change is imminent.

The Chiefs improved to 6-2 with their victory over the Jets , continuing their resurgence after missing the playoffs last season.

With important games against the Buffalo Bills and Los Angeles Rams approaching, Kansas City will be eager to ensure its quarterback recovers fully rather than risk worsening an injury that currently appears manageable.

articles.standfirst: Jackson Mahomes stepped into family mode before the Chiefs took the field, giving Brittany an extra hand with the kids
articles.summary: Jackson Mahomes stepped into family mode before the Chiefs took the field, giving Brittany an extra hand with the kids
articles.body:
P atrick Mahomes' brother was spotted helping Brittany Mahomes as the family arrived at the stadium ahead of Kansas City's Week 9 matchup against the New York Jets. Jackson took on some of the responsibilities, carrying one of the couple's children while also holding Sterling's hand as they walked toward the venue.

Patrick and Brittany's son, Bronze, followed closely behind the group. Jackson's involvement offered a glimpse of a different side of the Mahomes family, as he helped make the pregame arrival a little easier for Brittany.

Jackson Mahomes takes on family duties before kickoff

Jackson coordinated with the Chiefs' game-day atmosphere , wearing a red-and-white outfit while helping Brittany manage the children. Brittany, meanwhile, opted for a cheetah-print coat, stepping away from the red Chiefs-inspired looks she often wears to games.

The interaction highlighted their good relationship and how involved Patrick's brother is in helping his sister-in-law. It also gave fans a glimpse of the bond Jackson shares with the children and the role they play in his life.

The Mahomes family shares a close bond beyond football

With Patrick focused on his responsibilities with the Chiefs, J ackson stepped in to make Brittany's game-day routine easier. Having someone she trusts to help with the kids allows her to enjoy the experience with less pressure while being there to support her husband. His gesture also offered a different look at Jackson, showing that his life extends beyond the attention he receives as Patrick Mahomes' brother. Spending time with his nieces and nephews appears to be an important part of that role, especially during the football season.

As the Chiefs navigate a demanding stretch of the season, Jackson's presence is another example of how the Mahomes family stays connected while Patrick focuses on what happens on the field.

articles.title: Chiefs rumors heat up after Tyreek Hill’s former teammate drops major hint
articles.standfirst: A familiar face could be heading back to Kansas City. Tyreek Hill’s former teammate sparked speculation with a cryptic hint about a potential Chiefs move.
articles.summary: A familiar face could be heading back to Kansas City. Tyreek Hill’s former teammate sparked speculation with a cryptic hint about a potential Chiefs move.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs continue exploring options to strengthen their wide receiver room amid the inconsistent performances and injury concerns surrounding Rashee Rice and Xavier Worthy , who could miss multiple weeks after suffering a hamstring injury during the fourth quarter of the Week 9 win over the New York Jets .

Indianapolis Colts wide receiver Josh Downs has emerged as one of the most discussed potential targets for Kansas City, especially after the Jacksonville Jaguars appeared reluctant to trade young receiver Brian Thomas Jr. , a former first-round pick, to another contender.

However, the Chiefs could still have other options on the market, including a reunion that once seemed unlikely: the return of Tyreek Hill .

The former Kansas City star has resurfaced in trade and free-agent speculation as a potential addition, although his situation remains complicated. Hill is still recovering from a torn ACL suffered in September 2025 and could also face a suspension from the NFL.

Former Chiefs player fuels Tyreek Hill return rumors

Following Sunday’s win over the Jets, where Worthy suffered his injury, former Chiefs offensive lineman Jeff Allen posted a video on X with the message “Help is on the way” , adding only a crystal ball emoji as the caption.

The post quickly sparked speculation among Kansas City fans, who interpreted it as a possible hint that Allen may have knowledge of information that has not yet been made public.

While it could simply have been a prediction, the message reopened a scenario many had considered almost impossible: a potential Hill return to Arrowhead Stadium .

Chiefs Still Evaluating Offensive Options

Between his ongoing recovery and the possibility of a suspension of more than six games after being found liable for two counts of battery in October related to an incident involving his ex-wife Lakeeta Vaccaro Hill , there were questions about whether Tyreek Hill would play again this season.

However, a return has not been completely ruled out, and the Chiefs could explore a move for the All-Pro receiver if the circumstances allow.

That does not mean Kansas City has abandoned other targets like Josh Downs or Calvin Ridley of the Tennessee Titans . The Chiefs could even pursue multiple additions to provide more depth to a wide receiver group that has struggled with consistency throughout the season.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes could finally get deep threat Chiefs have been missing
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs may finally be ready to give Patrick Mahomes the explosive weapon his offense has been missing all season.
articles.summary: The Chiefs may finally be ready to give Patrick Mahomes the explosive weapon his offense has been missing all season.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs urgently need to reinforce their receiver group, especially after another hamstring injury cast doubt on Xavier Worthy’s availability. With the trade deadline set for Tuesday, Kansas City has one clear priority above the rest: Brian Thomas Jr.

According to Ian Rapoport of ESPN and NFL Network , the Jacksonville Jaguars wide receiver tops the Chiefs’ wish list and has become the offensive piece Patrick Mahomes ’ team is most interested in acquiring.

“The Kansas City Chiefs, they have been interested in Brian Thomas Jr. for some time, even going back to last year,” Rapoport explained. “It feels like a matter of when, not if. We just don’t know if that’s something that’s going to happen this season or maybe in the offseason.”

Jaguars could block a potential Chiefs move

Landing Thomas Jr. before the deadline would carry far greater value for Kansas City than waiting until the offseason. Mahomes has lacked a receiver capable of changing games with explosive plays ever since Tyquan Thornton suffered an anJagJaguars could block a potential Chiefs moveuars could block a potential Chiefs movekle dislocation in Week 4.

Although Xavier Worthy ran an impressive 4.21-second 40-yard dash at the 2024 NFL Combine , that speed has not consistently translated into a deep-threat presence against opposing defenses. A new injury only further complicates his immediate impact.

The Jaguars, however, have little incentive to make a deal with Kansas City easier. Jacksonville views the Chiefs as one of the primary rivals in the AFC championship race , alongside the Buffalo Bills, Cincinnati Bengals, and possibly the Denver Broncos.

“One of the issues for the Jaguars is how much do they want to help a team that could potentially be someone they would see down the road?” Rapoport continued. “But Brian Thomas Jr. seems to be the player that is garnering the most interest on the receiver market.”

Thomas shone in his Chiefs would have to pay a steep price for Thomas Jr.rookie season, finishing with 10 touchdowns and nearly 1,300 receiving yards after being selected in the first round of the draft. His production dropped in 2025 , and he has largely faded from prominence this season, totaling just seven targets and one catch for 12 yards across his last four combined games.

Chiefs would have to pay a steep price for Thomas Jr.

The Jaguars have made it clear they are all-in on a Super Bowl run after several aggressive moves in the market.

Jacksonville acquired defensive tackle Jordan Davis from the Philadelphia Eagles in exchange for a 2027 first-round pick and a 2029 second-round selection. They also sent a 2027 second-round pick and a 2028 fifth-rounder to the Atlanta Falcons for safety Jesse Bates, and added defensive tackle Davon Godchaux from the New Orleans Saints for a future sixth-round selection.

Sitting at 6-2 , the Jaguars are focused on winning now, which means future draft capital carries less weight in their immediate planning. That reduces any urgency to trade Thomas before the deadline.

For that reason, the price for the Chiefs could be high. If Kansas City wants the receiver Rapoport says they desire most on the market, they will likely need to put a second-round pick and another significant draft asset on the table to convince Jacksonville to make a deal.

articles.title: Bronze Mahomes starting to become a little too much like Patrick Mahomes, and Brittany can't believe it: “Yes you sure are kid”
articles.standfirst: The three-year-old has started copying his father's taste in music
articles.summary: The three-year-old has started copying his father's taste in music
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes has discovered that his influence extends well beyond the football field, with his three-year-old son Bronze developing a taste for rap music that has left the Kansas City Chiefs quarterback celebrating a small victory over his wife, Brittany.

The couple have different musical preferences, with Patrick favoring rap while Brittany frequently listens to country music. Until recently, their son appeared more accustomed to his mother's playlists, but spending time in the car with his father has apparently changed that.

Mahomes revealed the development in a lighthearted video shared by the Chiefs following their 35-12 victory over the New York Jets , explaining how Bronze had started requesting songs normally associated with his father's music collection.

The quarterback appeared particularly pleased that his son had developed an affection for "Walk Thru" by Rich Homie Quan, even asking Brittany to change the music when she was listening to country.

However, it was Brittany 's subsequent Instagram response that revealed just how enthusiastically Bronze had embraced his new favorite song.

During the Chiefs ' video, Mahomes was captured discussing his son's newfound interest in rap while preparing for Sunday's game against New York.

"My son, Brittany will be listening to music and that boy say, 'Hey, can I get that Walk Thru by Rich Homie Quan?'" Mahomes explained.

"I finally got Bronze on some like rap music a little bit because you know his mom always listens to country. He started riding with me, I started playing like clean rap music."

The three-time Super Bowl champion recalled receiving a message from Brittany after Bronze made another unexpected request during one of their listening sessions at home.

"Brittany texted me the other day, they're listening to country and he goes, 'Hey Mom, can you play Walk Thru by Rich Homie Quan,'" Mahomes said.

His excitement reflected more than simply introducing Bronze to a different genre, with the quarterback joking that the moment reminded him of his own relationship with his father.

Brittany subsequently reposted the video to her Instagram Stories, confirming that Bronze had become familiar enough with the song to repeat its lyrics.

"Bronze the other day 'I'm the man when I walk thru'. Yes you sure are kid," she wrote.

Brittany continues supporting Patrick

The exchange offered another glimpse into family life for Patrick and Brittany , who share three children: Sterling, five, Bronze, three, and Golden, who was born in January 2025.

Away from football, Mahomes has repeatedly spoken about the importance of his wife's support, particularly during his rehabilitation from the serious knee injury he suffered last season.

Speaking to Mitch Holthus on The Chiefs Kingdom Show, the quarterback explained that his recovery required lengthy daily sessions away from home, leaving Brittany responsible for additional family duties.

"It's a full commitment from the full family, and I think she did a great job of kind of being that leader of the household when I was having to be in the rehab facility," Mahomes said.

Brittany later shared the comments on Instagram, expressing her commitment to supporting her husband and children.

While the Chiefs continue monitoring their quarterback's recovery, Bronze 's increasingly familiar musical preferences have given Mahomes another reason to smile.

articles.title: Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift don't want a fight and find new allies following issues at $5.35 million Ohio mansion
articles.standfirst: The couple's Ohio renovation plans have divided nearby homeowners
articles.summary: The couple's Ohio renovation plans have divided nearby homeowners
articles.body:
Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce 's plans to create a private retreat near the shores of Lake Erie have become the subject of an increasingly public neighborhood disagreement, but not everyone in their new Ohio community believes the controversy reflects local sentiment.

The pop superstar and Kansas City Chiefs tight end purchased an eight-bedroom, 11-bathroom mansion in Bratenahl for $5.35 million in March, choosing a location just outside Cleveland, where Kelce grew up.

Their proposed renovations, including additional fencing and landscaping designed to improve privacy, have encountered opposition from homeowners concerned about the potential consequences for surrounding properties.

However, one resident has challenged the impression that the couple faces widespread hostility, insisting that most people in the exclusive lakeside village are pleased about their arrival.

"I think they're excited. I think it's great," the resident told Page Six. "I don't think people are angry."

The comments come as Bratenahl's Architectural Review Board prepares to reconsider the landscaping proposals on Tuesday, November 10, following earlier discussions about tree heights and the impact on neighboring properties.

While the dispute has attracted considerable media attention, the supportive resident believes the objections have come primarily from homeowners living immediately beside the mansion.

"I think it's just the neighbors on either side who object. I don't know why they object, they've done a really nice job fixing up the house," the source told Page Six.

The resident has reportedly contacted other community members ahead of the latest planning meeting, hoping to demonstrate that the criticism does not represent the entire neighborhood.

"We don't want them to feel unwelcome," the neighbor explained, adding that "the rest of the neighborhood will absolutely be supportive."

The couple haven't personally attended previous board meetings, instead relying on representatives to explain their proposals and address questions from local officials.

Their planner, Jacob Kutz of Tiny Construction, previously described the renovations as an effort to improve security and privacy following the high-profile property purchase.

The original proposal included an eight-foot fence, subsequently reduced to six feet, with the revised design stopping short of the lake.

Why mansion renovations remain controversial

Despite the emergence of local support, several homeowners maintain that the proposed changes could create practical problems extending beyond the couple's property.

Longtime resident Chuck Bauernschmidt has criticized the removal of existing vegetation and raised concerns that the fencing could present a danger to wildlife, particularly deer.

Another neighbor, Katherine Bolton , has questioned plans to plant evergreen trees near a shared sewer line more than a century old.

Bolton warned that growing roots could eventually damage the infrastructure, potentially resulting in expensive repairs, and previously cited an estimate of $75,000 for protective work.

The Architectural Review Board also delayed approval of the rear landscaping proposal in October after questioning whether the planned trees complied with local height restrictions.

Representatives for Swift and Kelce indicated they were willing to revise the design to meet the village's requirements, leaving the latest meeting as another opportunity to resolve outstanding concerns.

While the disagreement remains unresolved, the supportive resident hopes the couple will recognize that concerns over construction and landscaping don't necessarily translate into opposition to having them as neighbors.

articles.title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce face a christmas family dilemma as both sides make holiday plans
articles.standfirst: On July 2 of this year, Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift were married at Madison Square Garden in New York
articles.summary: On July 2 of this year, Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift were married at Madison Square Garden in New York
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs got the exact spark they needed with a dominant 35-12 victory over the New York Jets on Sunday, bouncing back after dropping their previous two contests to the Seahawks and Broncos.

Now, Kansas City looks to build momentum and find its rhythm across the next two games on the slate, traveling to face the Atlanta Falcons before returning home to host the Arizona Cardinals . Securing wins in these next two matchups is paramount before the team enters its most grueling stretch of the regular season.

Starting on Thanksgiving night, the Chiefs embark on a brutal three-game road gauntlet against the Buffalo Bills , Los Angeles Rams , and Cincinnati Bengals . They then return home to confront the New England Patriots before hosting the San Francisco 49ers on December 27th .

While every NFL game presents its own unique challenges, sweeping this upcoming lighter stretch is essential for Kansas City’s postseason positioning.

Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce Need Christmas Hosting Duties to Avoid Holiday Drama.

As the holiday season rapidly approaches, newlyweds Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce are navigating their first major Christmas decision as a married couple, working to balance family traditions between both sides.

Reports indicate the pop icon and the All-Pro tight end have been weighing where to spend the festivities, as Swift has traditionally centered her holidays around her parents, Andrea and Scott Swift , while Kelce remains equally devoted to his family circle.

To prevent their inaugural Christmas together from turning into a holiday tug-of-war or disappointing their loved ones, the couple is exploring a plan to host both families under one roof in Kansas City .

Gathering everyone in Missouri allows both families to celebrate together while keeping Kelce completely focused on the gridiron, where he continues to anchor the offense with team leading 33 receptions and 482 receiving yards , plus two touchdowns on the year.

With this likely marking the final chapter of his historic career, Kelce remains determined to cap his legacy with a fourth Super Bowl ring, starting with business in Atlanta.

articles.title: Here's the special Thanksgiving menu Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce are offering for just over $100
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City steakhouse is offering an upscale holiday experience, with prime rib, lobster bisque and traditional turkey among the featured dishes
articles.summary: The Kansas City steakhouse is offering an upscale holiday experience, with prime rib, lobster bisque and traditional turkey among the featured dishes
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce are preparing to bring a different kind of Thanksgiving celebration to Kansas City, with their luxury restaurant, 1587 Prime, offering a special holiday dining experience that combines traditional favorites with its signature steakhouse menu.

The Kansas City Chiefs stars have built one of the NFL's most successful on-field partnerships, but their latest business venture is providing another opportunity to connect with fans away from football.

Their restaurant, which opened in September 2025, will welcome diners on Thursday, November 26, from 2 p.m. until 8 p.m., introducing a seasonal selection featuring turkey, prime rib and several festive extras.

The announcement comes during an ongoing trademark dispute involving the restaurant's name, although the legal proceedings have not interrupted plans for the upcoming holiday service.

Diners can spend just over $100 by combining the restaurant's premium prime rib with its lobster bisque, while those seeking a more traditional Thanksgiving dinner have a less expensive turkey option.

What's on Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce's Thanksgiving menu?

1587 Prime is offering five featured dishes and drinks for Thanksgiving, with prices reflecting the restaurant's position in Kansas City's luxury dining market.

The most expensive individual item is a 16-ounce prime rib priced at $80, providing an alternative to the turkey traditionally associated with the holiday.

Guests who prefer a conventional Thanksgiving centerpiece can select stuffed turkey roulade for $55 per person.

The special menu also features lobster bisque for $22, pumpkin cake for $18 and a seasonal Gather & Give cocktail priced at $19.

A guest ordering prime rib and lobster bisque would spend $102 before taxes and gratuity, while choosing the turkey with pumpkin cake would cost $73.

Those prices represent individual menu selections rather than a fixed Thanksgiving package, allowing customers to tailor their meals according to their preferences.

The holiday service provides another opportunity for Mahomes and Kelce to promote their restaurant, which takes its name from their respective Chiefs jersey numbers, 15 and 87.

Why are Mahomes and Kelce involved in a legal dispute over 1587 Prime?

While the steakhouse prepares for Thanksgiving, its owners remain involved in a federal trademark infringement lawsuit filed by 1587 Sneakers, a footwear and apparel company.

The business filed its complaint in February, alleging that the restaurant's name and associated merchandise could create confusion with its existing brand.

Mahomes , Kelce and hospitality partner Noble 33 were among the defendants named in the proceedings.

The football stars' legal representatives have sought dismissal of the claims against them, arguing that their involvement does not establish the legal basis required to hold them personally responsible.

However, 1587 Sneakers has challenged that position, maintaining that the players were central to developing and promoting the restaurant's identity.

In a court filing, the company argued that Mahomes and Kelce were the "moving forces" behind the disputed name because it was created from their jersey numbers.

The allegations remain contested, and no finding of trademark infringement has been established.

Meanwhile, the restaurant continues operating as normal, with its Thanksgiving offering providing a new attraction for diners looking to celebrate the holiday in Kansas City.

articles.title: Gracie Hunt celebrates her bachelorette as an impromptu swimsuit model: “Not all of us can walk the VS runway”
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City Chiefs heiress traded football festivities for a sun-soaked bachelorette celebration in Mexico
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs heiress traded football festivities for a sun-soaked bachelorette celebration in Mexico
articles.body:
Gracie Hunt is making the most of her final celebrations before marriage, and her latest bachelorette party gave her followers a glimpse of a very different side of the Kansas City Chiefs heiress.

While the Chiefs were preparing for their NFL commitments, Hunt travelled to Mexico with friends and family for a weekend she called her "last splash."

The mermaid-themed celebration featured a private yacht, mariachi music, fireworks and plenty of time enjoying the sunshine.

However, it was one particular Instagram caption that attracted attention. Posing aboard the yacht in a white bikini, a sheer shirt and a matching cowboy hat, Hunt joked about her unexpected appearance as a swimsuit model.

"Not all of us can walk the VS runway, some of us gotta hold it down at my bach," she wrote.

The comment was a playful reference to the Victoria's Secret fashion show, with Hunt clearly enjoying the opportunity to have some fun during the celebrations.

Her weekend began on Friday, when she shared a video showing her changing from a white embroidered two-piece outfit into a floral embroidered maxi dress for the evening. She captioned the post "Hi night 1," giving followers an early look at the festivities.

The celebrations continued over the following days, with group workouts, beach activities and time in the water forming part of the itinerary. Guests were also treated to Mexican food, while personalized gifts and luxury items were included in their goodie bags.

Hunt's younger sister, Ava , who is serving as maid of honor, also made the trip after attending an SMU game on Saturday.

When Gracie shared pictures of her champagne-nude maxi dress from the bachelorette dinner, Ava responded with an enthusiastic "Oh my gosh," comment.

Their mother, Tavia Hunt , was equally involved in the celebrations. After Gracie posted a video of herself jumping with excitement, Tavia responded: "You're still a monkey jumping on the bed!"

A wedding bringing two Chiefs families together

The celebrations mark another milestone in Hunt's relationship with Derek Green , whose father, Trent Green , enjoyed a successful NFL career that included six seasons with Kansas City between 2001 and 2007.

The couple's connection stretches back much further than their public romance. They first knew each other as children because of their families' involvement with the Chiefs , before reconnecting as adults in 2017. Their relationship eventually became public in May 2025.

Hunt announced their engagement on April 4, 2026, sharing photographs of Green's proposal and expressing her excitement about their future together: "Over our eight years of friendship, we almost started dating more times than I can count, but God kept saying wait…and I didn't always understand why."

The engagement was particularly meaningful because both families were present for the occasion. Green proposed during a family trip to Mexico, with the celebration subsequently bringing together the Hunts and Greens.

The engagement ring also carried personal significance. Green helped design the elongated cushion-cut diamond, incorporating two emeralds as a reference to his surname.

Hunt has also shared glimpses of the wedding preparations, including a trip to New York with her mother and sister to look for a dress. The couple have not publicly confirmed their wedding date.

More than just a Chiefs heiress

Hunt is known to football fans as the daughter of Clark Hunt, chairman and CEO of the Kansas City Chiefs, but she has also developed her own public profile.

A former Miss Kansas USA, she studied journalism, applied psychology and sport management at Southern Methodist University.

She has worked with the Chiefs on marketing and brand development and has been involved with Special Olympics initiatives and charitable projects.

Her bachelorette weekend offered a more personal look at the celebrations surrounding her upcoming marriage. Between the yacht, beach activities and playful swimsuit photos, Hunt appeared determined to enjoy every moment with the people closest to her.

And judging by her Victoria's Secret joke, she was more than happy to embrace the spotlight, even if the runway was a private yacht rather than a fashion show.

Her weekend began on Friday, when she shared a video showing her changing from a white embroidered two-piece outfit into a floral embroidered maxi dress for the evening. She captioned the post "Hi night 1," giving followers an early look at the festivities.

The celebrations continued over the following days, with group workouts, beach activities and time in the water forming part of the itinerary. Guests were also treated to Mexican food, while personalized gifts and luxury items were included in their goodie bags.
Hunt's younger sister, Ava , who is serving as maid of honor, also made the trip after attending an SMU game on Saturday.
When Gracie shared pictures of her champagne-nude maxi dress from the bachelorette dinner, Ava responded with an enthusiastic "Oh my gosh," comment.
Their mother, Tavia Hunt , was equally involved in the celebrations. After Gracie posted a video of herself jumping with excitement, Tavia responded: "You're still a monkey jumping on the bed!"
A wedding bringing two Chiefs families together

The celebrations mark another milestone in Hunt's relationship with Derek Green , whose father, Trent Green , enjoyed a successful NFL career that included six seasons with Kansas City between 2001 and 2007.

The couple's connection stretches back much further than their public romance. They first knew each other as children because of their families' involvement with the Chiefs , before reconnecting as adults in 2017. Their relationship eventually became public in May 2025.

Hunt announced their engagement on April 4, 2026, sharing photographs of Green's proposal and expressing her excitement about their future together: "Over our eight years of friendship, we almost started dating more times than I can count, but God kept saying wait…and I didn't always understand why."

The engagement was particularly meaningful because both families were present for the occasion. Green proposed during a family trip to Mexico, with the celebration subsequently bringing together the Hunts and Greens.
The engagement ring also carried personal significance. Green helped design the elongated cushion-cut diamond, incorporating two emeralds as a reference to his surname.
Hunt has also shared glimpses of the wedding preparations, including a trip to New York with her mother and sister to look for a dress. The couple have not publicly confirmed their wedding date.
More than just a Chiefs heiress
Hunt is known to football fans as the daughter of Clark Hunt, chairman and CEO of the Kansas City Chiefs, but she has also developed her own public profile.
A former Miss Kansas USA, she studied journalism, applied psychology and sport management at Southern Methodist University.
She has worked with the Chiefs on marketing and brand development and has been involved with Special Olympics initiatives and charitable projects.

Her bachelorette weekend offered a more personal look at the celebrations surrounding her upcoming marriage. Between the yacht, beach activities and playful swimsuit photos, Hunt appeared determined to enjoy every moment with the people closest to her.
And judging by her Victoria's Secret joke, she was more than happy to embrace the spotlight, even if the runway was a private yacht rather than a fashion show.

articles.title: Chiefs eye double wide receiver move with Josh Downs and Hollywood Brown in play
articles.standfirst: The potential acquisition would address one of the Chiefs’ most pressing offensive concerns
articles.summary: The potential acquisition would address one of the Chiefs’ most pressing offensive concerns
articles.body:
T he Kansas City Chiefs may have rediscovered their offensive rhythm, but general manager Brett Veach apparently isn’t ready to stand pat as the NFL trade deadline approaches. Despite a productive performance in their latest game, the Chiefs are reportedly leading the race to acquire Indianapolis Colts wide receiver Josh Downs , a move that could give Patrick Mahomes another much-needed weapon for the second half of the season.

According to NFL insider Charles Robinson in his latest Substack report , multiple league sources identified Kansas City as “the leader” in the pursuit of Downs as of Monday afternoon. The two teams have reportedly been discussing compensation, with Indianapolis seeking a third-round draft pick while already having at least one offer involving a fourth-round selection.

Although a deal has yet to be finalized, Kansas City is expected to be in a strong position to land the 24-year-old receiver before Tuesday’s trade deadline. The potential acquisition would address one of the Chiefs’ most pressing offensive concerns : a receiving corps that has struggled to provide consistent production since Tyquan Thornton suffered a season-ending injury.

Why Josh Downs could be exactly what Patrick Mahomes needs

Kansas City’s offensive numbers suggest a team that should have few problems moving the football. Entering Week 10, the Chiefs rank 11th in Dropback EPA, 10th in passing yards per game with 246.4, and ninth in both yards per attempt (7.7) and passing touchdown rate (5.3%).

Of Mahomes’ 2,037 passing yards this season, approximately 64.6% have come from running backs, tight ends or players who are now unavailable for the remainder of the campaign. That includes 219 yards from Thornton, 409 from running backs Emmett Johnson and Kenneth Walker III, and 666 from Travis Kelce and Noah Gray.

The imbalance highlights Kansas City’s dependence on its running backs and tight ends, particularly when it comes to generating reliable production through the air. Downs could help change that dynamic. At 5-foot-9, the Indianapolis receiver isn’t a direct replacement for Thornton’s ability to stretch the field vertically.

Instead, his greatest strength is creating separation quickly and giving his quarterback a dependable option in the short and intermediate passing game. He already demonstrated that ability against Kansas City in Week 2, recording seven receptions for 72 yards against the Chiefs defense.

A change of scenery could benefit Downs

Adding a receiver capable of consistently getting open could make a significant difference for Mahomes. Downs’ route-running ability and quickness would give the quarterback another option when defenses concentrate on Kelce or attempt to disrupt Kansas City’s passing game.

A trade could also represent an important opportunity for Downs , who is playing in a contract year. His production in Indianapolis has been affected by the inconsistency of the Colts’ passing attack . Quarterback Daniel Jones has an On-Target Rate of just 66.3%, one of the lowest marks among starting quarterbacks, according to the statistics provided.

Mahomes, meanwhile, ranks sixth in the NFL with a 78.4% On-Target Rate. That difference could be particularly important for a receiver whose game depends on precise timing, separation and reliable connections with his quarterback.

A move to Kansas City would place Downs in an offense with an established quarterback capable of maximizing his strengths. It could also give him an opportunity to improve his market value ahead of free agency.

Hollywood Brown could be another Chiefs trade target

Downs might not be the only receiver Kansas City considers before the deadline. The Philadelphia Eagles are reportedly operating as sellers, potentially opening the door for the Chiefs to pursue veteran wide receiver Hollywood Brown.

The 29-year-old previously played in Kansas City and could offer some familiarity with Mahomes’ offensive system . Last season, Brown recorded 587 receiving yards and five touchdowns with the Chiefs while receiving 12 deep targets.

His current situation in Philadelphia has been considerably less productive. Through four games this season, he has managed just five receptions for 63 yards, making him a potential trade candidate if the Eagles are willing to move him.

Kansas City could explore a deal involving a Day 3 draft-pick swap to bring Brown back. Adding both Downs and Brown would give the Chiefs two different types of receiving threats. Downs could provide reliable separation underneath, while Brown would offer experience and the ability to attack defenses downfield. That combination could be especially valuable for an offense that has struggled to replace Thornton’s contributions.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes denied another star weapon after Chiefs' final trade decision
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs explored a blockbuster move before the NFL trade deadline, but their top target was never available.
articles.summary: The Chiefs explored a blockbuster move before the NFL trade deadline, but their top target was never available.
articles.body:
With the trade deadline rapidly approaching, the Kansas City Chiefs succeeded in adding weapons to the offense led by Patrick Mahomes — though one of the team’s top targets delivered a firm “no” to the franchise looking to return to a Super Bowl .

In Kansas City, they are celebrating the arrival of wide receiver Josh Down s, acquired in exchange for a fourth-round pick and a fifth-round selection . While he was one of the stronger options to reinforce the position, the possibility of landing Brian Thomas Jr. existed as well, but the Jaguars rejected any potential deal.

Chiefs rumors: Jaguars rejected trade offers for Brian Thomas Jr.

ESPN reporter Jeremy Fowler reported that the Jacksonville Jaguars pulled wide receiver Brian Thomas Jr. off the market ahead of the NFL trade deadline.

“The Jaguars plan to keep WR Brian Thomas Jr. through the trade deadline, per sources,” Fowler noted in a November 10 message on X. “They have relayed that to interested teams.

“Coming off multiple big trades Monday, Jacksonville plans to keep its roster intact, barring a surprise.”

Chiefs couldn’t land a star receiver because targets were ‘off the market’

Before the trade deadline closed, Kansas City Chiefs general manager Brett Veach indicated that the team was unable to complete a deal for a top-tier wide receiver. CBS Sports reporter Tracy Wolfson revealed that several players considered “franchise” talents whom Kansas City attempted to acquire were simply unavailable.

“Guys, we’ve been talking about the lack of deep threats for the Chiefs, and I spoke with GM Brett Veach before the game, he told me that as the trade deadline approaches, the focus continues to be at that wide receiver position,” Wolfson said on November 8 during the Jets-Chiefs game.

“There has been increased dialogue this week, and he found that some of the major franchise players they looked at are off the market, but they will continue to have conversations over the next 24 hours to see if they can get something done by the trade deadline.”

It remains to be seen whether the franchise’s decisions will pay off. What is clear is that the Chiefs needed help to take their offense to another level.
